The Technical Service Representative serves as an experienced technical resource responsible for independently supporting customers, contractors, distributors, and internal stakeholders through technical troubleshooting, complaint investigations, field service activities, product demonstrations, inspections, and training initiatives. This position supports the objectives of the Technical Service department by providing timely customer support, managing technical issues, and ensuring accurate documentation of all technical service activities.

The Technical Service Representative is responsible for independently managing customer support requests, conducting field investigations, gathering and analyzing technical information, and maintaining accurate records within HubSpot and FastField. This role collaborates closely with Sales, Quality, Operations, Manufacturing, and National Technical Service Manager to resolve customer concerns, support business growth, and improve customer satisfaction.

The Technical Service Representative is expected to demonstrate strong technical knowledge, sound judgment, effective communication skills, and a commitment to continuous improvement. This position serves as a trusted technical resource for assigned customers and territories while supporting department goals related to customer service, complaint management, documentation quality, safety, and operational excellence.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

* None.
* May assist in the onboarding and training of Technical Service Associate personnel.
* May provide guidance and technical assistance to less experienced Technical Service team members.
* May lead customer demonstrations, training events, field evaluations, and complaint investigations as assigned.
* May serve as a technical resource for Sales, Operations, Quality, and other internal stakeholders.
* Supports the National Technical Service Manager by promoting compliance with department procedures, documentation standards, HubSpot requirements, FastField reporting requirements, and customer service expectations.
* May assist with the development and implementation of training materials, best practices, and technical resources.

Duties/Responsibilities:

* Independently manage customer support requests, technical inquiries, field service activities, and assigned customer accounts.
* Prioritize customer requests based on urgency, business impact, and customer needs while maintaining proactive communication throughout the resolution process.
* Conduct customer visits, jobsite inspections, complaint investigations, product evaluations, and field troubleshooting activities.
* Serve as a primary technical resource for assigned customers, contractors, distributors, and sales personnel.
* Develop and maintain strong working relationships with assigned customers, contractors, distributors, and internal stakeholders to promote customer satisfaction, retention, and business growth.
* Lead routine customer complaint investigations by gathering information, evaluating findings, coordinating with internal departments, identifying potential root causes, recommending corrective actions, and ensuring all investigation activities are accurately documented within HubSpot.
* Complete FastField reports thoroughly, accurately, and in accordance with established department standards and timelines.
* Collect and communicate customer feedback, product performance observations, competitive intelligence, market trends, and field data to National Technical Service Manager.
* Conduct product demonstrations, contractor training programs, customer education sessions, and technical presentations.
* Maintain advanced working knowledge of company products, application methods, processing equipment, emerging technologies, and industry best practices.
* Collaborate with Sales to support customer retention, business development opportunities, product evaluations, and technical support requests.
* Assist in the development and maintenance of technical documentation, application guidelines, standard operating procedures, training materials, and best practices.
* Promote compliance with company policies, safety requirements, department procedures, documentation standards, and customer service expectations.
* Maintain technical service equipment, demonstration equipment, vehicles, tools, inventory, and departmental assets in a safe and professional manner.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on customer support, complaint management, documentation quality, field reporting, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
* Assist National Technical Service Manager in identifying recurring customer issues, training opportunities, process improvements, and areas requiring additional support or resources.
* Represent the company professionally during customer visits, demonstrations, training events, industry events, and other customer-facing activities.
* Continue developing technical expertise, leadership abilities, customer management skills, and independent decision-making capabilities consistent with advancement to Senior Technical Service Representative.

Required Skills/Abilities:

* Bilingual proficiency is a plus but not required
* Strong knowledge of spray foam insulation products, polyurethane systems, application techniques, processing equipment, and troubleshooting practices.
* Ability to exercise sound technical judgment while resolving customer issues within established department procedures and company guidelines.
* Strong understanding of customer complaint management, technical investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action processes.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple customer issues, projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong customer service orientation with the ability to build and maintain positive relationships with customers, contractors, distributors, and internal stakeholders.
* Ability to effectively communicate technical information verbally and in writing to a variety of audiences.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate documentation and records.
* Proficiency in HubSpot, FastField, Microsoft Office Suite, and other company software systems used for customer support, reporting, and documentation.
* Ability to collect, analyze, and communicate field intelligence, customer feedback, product performance observations, and market information.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to exercise sound judgment and make independent decisions within established guidelines.
* Mechanical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot spray foam processing equipment, transfer pumps, spray guns, proportioners, and related systems.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining communication and alignment with department objectives.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Quality, Operations, Manufacturing, R&D, and other cross-functional teams.
* Strong presentation and training skills with the ability to conduct customer demonstrations, contractor training, and technical education programs.
* Commitment to safety, professionalism, continuous improvement, and customer satisfaction.
* Ability to travel extensively and represent the company professionally in customer-facing environments.
* Bilingual (Spanish) communication skills preferred but not required.

Education and Experience:

* High school diploma or GED required.
* Associate degree, technical certification, vocational training, or equivalent industry experience preferred.
* Minimum of three (3) to five (5) years of experience in spray foam insulation, polyurethane systems, construction materials, specialty chemicals, manufacturing, technical service, field support, or a related industry.
* Demonstrated experience conducting customer visits, technical troubleshooting, field investigations, complaint management, product demonstrations, or technical support activities.
* Experience working directly with contractors, distributors, customers, sales personnel, or other customer-facing technical support functions preferred.
* Experience utilizing CRM systems, customer support platforms, field reporting software, and documentation systems. HubSpot and FastField experience preferred.
* Experience delivering customer training, product demonstrations, technical presentations, or contractor education programs preferred.
* Working knowledge of spray foam processing equipment, application techniques, troubleshooting procedures, and industry best practices.
* Industry certifications, training, or active participation in organizations such as SPFA, CPI, ACC, ICC, or related industry groups preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage customer issues, technical investigations, field support activities, and documentation requirements with minimal supervision.

Physical Requirements:

* Ability to occasionally lift and move equipment, demonstration materials, samples, tools, and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds.
* Travel up to 70% of the time, including overnight travel, to support customer visits, jobsite inspections, complaint investigations, demonstrations, training events, trade shows, and company meetings.
* Ability to operate company vehicles and maintain a valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.
* Ability to wear and work in required personal protective equipment (PPE), including respirators, safety glasses, hearing protection, hard hats, protective clothing, and other safety equipment as required.
* Ability to work safely in manufacturing facilities, warehouses, customer locations, active construction sites, and other industrial environments.
* Ability to sit, stand, walk, bend, kneel, climb ladders, and perform field inspections for extended periods of time.
* Ability to work in varying environmental conditions, including heat, cold, humidity, confined spaces, elevated work areas, and outdoor jobsite conditions.
* Ability to operate, inspect, and troubleshoot spray foam processing equipment, transfer pumps, spray guns, hoses, and related equipment.
* Ability to load, unload, transport, and set up demonstration equipment, training materials, and technical service tools as required.
* Ability to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, and through electronic communication platforms while supporting customers and internal stakeholders.
* Ability to travel by automobile and commercial airline as required to support business objectives and customer needs

9c1dec07d2df5a960f62.description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

The Tier 2 SME provides advanced sustainment, deployment, and lifecycle support for Joint Operational Medicine Information Systems (JOMIS) Health Care Delivery (HCD) mobile and web applications. This role ensures successful operation, troubleshooting, readiness, and fielding of HCD capabilities across deployed, operational, and enterprise environments. The SME also supports related hosting platforms, mobile devices, and associated system integrations in alignment with JOMIS program objectives and DoD health IT requirements. Primary work locations in San Antonio, TX, and Falls Church, VA. Remote work may be possible with approval from the customer.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as a Tier 2 technical expert for JOMIS HCD mobile and web applications, providing advanced troubleshooting, root‑cause analysis, and problem resolution for incidents escalated from Tier 1 support.
* Provide sustainment and operational support for all HCD capability components, including application services, hosting environments, mobile devices, system configurations, and data workflows across enterprise, disconnected, and tactical settings.
* Support deployment activities, including environment preparation, configuration validation, installation guidance, version upgrades, system integration testing, and post‑deployment functional verification.
* Collaborate with engineering, product teams, cybersecurity, and hosting/platform operations to ensure stable, secure, and compliant application performance.
* Monitor system health, logs, and performance metrics; identify issues early and recommend improvements to enhance reliability, usability, and operational readiness.
* Maintain deep knowledge of mobile device management (MDM) platforms, secure application distribution processes, and DoD mobility and hosting standards.
* Assist in documentation development, including SOPs, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, deployment checklists, and system configuration references.
* Support change management processes including release readiness, coordinated updates, and communication for system changes affecting the operational user community.
* Provide expert guidance to end users, training leads, and support technicians regarding HCD workflows, system functionality, and operational use cases.
* Participate in technical working groups, configuration control boards, and readiness reviews as a recognized SME for HCD capabilities.
* Ensure compliance with DoD cybersecurity, RMF controls, data handling policies, and accreditation requirements across mobile and hosting platforms.

**Required Skills:**

* Experience supporting DoD health IT systems, operational medical applications, or similar enterprise mobile/web systems in a Tier 2 or SME capacity.
* Strong understanding of JOMIS, HCD capabilities, or equivalent operational medical information systems.

030f4e58e8506dcf09b3.title: Industrial Services Specialist (Training Coordinator)
030f4e58e8506dcf09b3.description:
At Interplay we believe the skilled trades and industrial crafts workforce deserves training that keeps them safe, confident and ready for the job in front of them. Together with Industrial Training International (ITI), the global leader in specialized industrial learning solutions, we combine instructor-led training, online simulations, AI, and VR to help organizations and educational institutions upskill faster, reduce risk, and increase operational readiness.

We’ve helped train nearly **600,000 people** and counting and we're building the workforce that keeps the physical world running.

Visit interplaylearning.com to learn more.

**Interplay Ethos:**

*At Interplay, we* ***love what we do****. We embrace our daily challenge to push technological limits to invent better ways to make learning easier and training more powerful. We attract* ***passionate*** *people and invite* ***spirited discourse****. We celebrate that our* ***jobs fit our lives****, not the inverse. We are uncompromising in our belief that* ***together: we can*** *build better training, build better careers and build better lives for customers and our team.*

Our culture is grounded in these ethos, hear more about them from our CEO and founder, Doug Donovan.

**Awards & Recognition:**

* 2026 & 2025, *Forbes,* *America’s Best Startup Employers*
* *2026, TIME, World’s Top EdTech Companies*
* 2026, *Inc. 5000, Fastest-Growing U.S. Companies (2025, 2022, 2018)*
* *2024, Best Midsize Places to Work In Austin*
* 2024, *Facilitiesnet Readers' Choice Award Winners for Software*
* 2024, *AHR Expo Innovation Awards Winners for Software*

***Interplay uses AI to support the recruiting/hiring process, but all hiring decisions are made by humans.***

**Position:** Industrial Services Specialist

**Department:** Industrial Services Operations

**Location:** Remote (U.S.), with occasional onsite days at our training centers. Application questionnaire asks for more info about your location and travel capabilities.

**Type:** Full-time with benefits, paid hourly (35-40 hours per week expected)

At Interplay, we pair hands-on, instructor-led training with digital training, simulations and skill verification to help trades technicians learn, grow and build better careers. In this role, you’ll support the open enrollment, instructor-led courses at our training centers, including crane operation, rigging, inspection, lift planning and NCCCO certification prep. You’ll make sure students, customers and partners are registered, prepared and supported throughout the training process.

This role blends people and process. You’ll be a main point of contact for students and customers through phone call and email. Along with keeping accurate records, rosters and payments in our systems. Experience with customer service or program coordination/management and data entry is highly preferred.

This is a job for someone that loves variety, takes pride in getting the details right, and wants to grow with us!

**Why this role?**

* Mission-driven company and innovative product offering
* Career development in a dynamic, high growth environment
* Passionate, collaborative team
* Real variety: customer service, data, coordination and a sales support
* Mostly remote with flexible hours

**What you’ll do:**

* **Be the front line for our training centers:** Answer inbound calls and emails, help students and customers register for programs, and handle reschedules and routine payment transactions.
* **Get students ready for class:** Reach out ahead of upcoming programs to confirm attendance and make sure names and details are correct.
* **Close the loop after class:** Process certificates, qualification cards and student records so every completed program is fully documented.
* **Keep our systems accurate:** Manage course calendars and event details in Salesforce and related systems (NetSuite, Shopify and partner portals), and follow up on open invoices.
* **Partner with training facilities and Sales:** Coordinate program logistics with our training center partners, track class capacity, and flag under-filled courses to Sales early so classes run full.
* **Solve problems and pitch in on projects:** Troubleshoot day-to-day customer and data issues, raise blockers early, and help with data cleanup and team improvement projects.

**Who you are:**

* **Detail-obsessed:** You take pride in getting names, dates, rosters and data entry right the first time, and you catch errors before they become problems.
* **Customer-first:** You're calm, warm and professional on the phone and in writing, even when the phones are busy.
* **A finisher:** You see tasks through from start to finish, and you aren't afraid of the routine work that keeps things running.
* **A clear communicator:** You flag issues and blockers early and keep your manager and teammates in the loop.
* **A collaborator:** You build easy working relationships with training center partners and internal teams.
* **Eager to learn:** You ask good questions, pick up new systems quickly, and take initiative to find the next thing to do.
* **You live our ethos:** You love the work, bring passion and spirited discourse, and believe that together we can build better careers and better lives.

**Requirements:**

* 3+ years of customer-facing experience, such as customer service or support, customer operations, order management, training administration, inside sales or program coordination.
* Strong data entry skills and a track record of accuracy in detail-heavy work.
* Comfort handling a steady flow of phone calls and customer transactions, including payments.
* Experience supporting students, learners or customers from start to finish, such as answering program questions, helping with enrollment and scheduling, and following up after class.
* Experience with a CRM. Salesforce is a plus; we'll teach you our systems.
* Ability to work a full-time schedule during business hours. Central, Mountain or Pacific time zones are preferred to align with our training programs.
* Ability to travel to a training center about 1–2 days a month, plus a few days of in-person onboarding in your first 1–2 months. Travel is reimbursed.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with event registration, scheduling or training/education operations.
* Familiarity with industrial, skilled trades or safety training.
* Experience with NetSuite, Shopify or payment processing tools.
* Living near one of our training centers - Houston, TX; Memphis, TN; Woodland, WA; Cleveland, OH or Lakeland, FL

**Pay:** $26–$37 per hour

*Final compensation will reflect the candidate's experience and demonstrated impact.*

**Schedule & travel:** This is a full-time role, 40 hours a week, with flexible hours during the business day. Most of your work is remote. You'll spend about 1–2 days a month onsite supporting programs at a training center, with reimbursed travel.

**What to expect from our interview process**

We know your time is valuable, so here's a general sense of what to expect:

* Recruiter intro call
* Short skills exercise (completed remotely)
* Hiring manager conversation
* Team or peer panel interview

Interviews are conducted remotely unless a step calls for something different. Following an offer of employment, all roles require a background check and a drug and alcohol screening. See the Compliance and Onboarding section below for details.

**Compliance & Onboarding:**

* Candidates must be residents of the United States.
* Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship required.
* Following the offer of employment, all roles will require a background check and a drug and alcohol test. Some positions may require other verifications, such as, driver eligibility and record, credentials or education. All new hires will be required to complete the I-9 Form and E-verify process upon employment.

**Benefits & Perks - Why you’ll love working with us:**

* **Remote-first & flexible hours** – Offices in Austin, TX; Deer Park, TX; Woodland, WA; and Cleveland, OH.
* **Learning & growth** – Annual learning reimbursement.
* **Family-friendly policies** – Support for work-life balance.
* **Generous paid time off** **package** – 3 weeks PTO, 1 week Winter Break, observed holidays, sick days, and others.
* **Comprehensive benefits** – Medical, vision, dental, and 401(k) match.
* **Equity** – Private Company Equity Options
* **Wellness –** Mental and physical health resources and social events.

Join us and grow with a team that values you!

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

*Interplay is committed to providing equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all qualified employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, marital status, gender identity or expression, status as a veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic or activity in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.*

*As a federal contractor, Interplay takes affirmative action to consider qualified individuals without regard for disability and protected veterans status.*

*Individuals with disabilities who need assistance with the application or recruitment process must promptly contact the HR Department to discuss their particular needs.*

*Interplay does not discriminate against employees or applicants for discussing, disclosing, or inquiring about compensation.*

**Drug Testing & Background Testing**

*The company conducts background checks as part of the hiring process after extending an offer of employment. These screenings are facilitated by trusted third-party specialists. All positions require I-9 verification, E-Verify, a background check, and a drug and alcohol screening. Depending on the role, additional screenings may include employment history verification, a DMV record check, reference checks, education and credential verification, or a credit history review.*

*We believe in fostering a welcoming and inclusive workplace and encourage everyone to apply, regardless of background. Our hiring decisions are guided by skills, experience, and a shared commitment to our values. If you have any questions about our process, we’re happy to provide support and guidance along the way.*

76a96e158a6eedfbed3d.title: Member & Provider Services Specialist - Remote
76a96e158a6eedfbed3d.description:
**Harbor Health**

**Member and Provider Services Specialist**

Remote - Texas Based

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

  

Harbor Health is seeking a compassionate, highly skilled, and solution-oriented Member & Provider Services Specialist to join our innovative, integrated healthcare organization. As a key ambassador of the Harbor Health experience, you will serve as a trusted resource for members, providers, and business partners by delivering exceptional service across both our health plan and medical group. You will support a broad spectrum of member and provider inquiries throughout the healthcare journey — including educating members on benefits and coverage, resolving claims and billing questions, supporting enrollment and eligibility, assisting with referrals and prior authorizations, and managing complaints, grievances, and appeals in accordance with regulatory requirements. This role is central to delivering Harbor Health's commitment to a unified, frictionless, member-centered experience that aligns with our mission of transforming healthcare through our payvider model.

  

**POSITION DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

**Member Services**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for members through phone, email, chat, and other communication channels
* Educate members regarding health plan benefits, eligibility, covered services, exclusions, deductibles, copays, coinsurance, and out-of-pocket responsibilities
* Assist members with provider selection, appointment scheduling, referrals, and navigation throughout the healthcare system
* Guide members through enrollment, eligibility updates, PCP changes, and Marketplace or Large Group insurance questions
* Assist members with portal registration and digital self-service tools
* Promote first-call resolution while delivering a personalized, empathetic member experience

**Provider Services**

* Serve as a primary resource for participating and non-participating providers
* Support provider inquiries regarding member eligibility, benefits, claim status, payment, referrals, prior authorizations, and network participation
* Educate providers on Provider Relations and Network Management processes to resolve provider concerns efficiently

**Eligibility & Benefits**

* Verify member eligibility and benefits using Athena, payer portals, and internal systems
* Confirm benefit coverage, network participation, plan limitations (HMO, PPO, POS, Marketplace, etc.), and applicable member financial responsibility
* Educate members regarding referral requirements and available in-network resources to improve access and reduce out-of-pocket costs
* Resolve eligibility discrepancies by working directly with health plans or guiding members through corrective actions

**Claims & Billing Support**

* Research and resolve claims inquiries for members and providers
* Explain claim adjudication, payment determinations, denials, coordination of benefits, and reimbursement processes
* Assist with billing questions, patient balances, payment options, and payment plan information
* Escalate complex financial or reimbursement issues to Claims or Billing teams while maintaining ownership of the member experience

**Prior Authorization & Referrals**

* Educate members and providers regarding prior authorization requirements, referral processes, and documentation needs
* Explain authorization status, next steps, and expected turnaround times
* Coordinate with Utilization Management and Clinical Operations to facilitate timely resolution

**Appeals, Grievances & Complaints**

* Intake and document member and provider complaints, grievances, and appeals accurately and completely
* Ensure all required documentation is collected to support investigations and regulatory review
* Maintain compliance with CMS, TDI, NCQA, HIPAA, and Harbor Health policies
* Escalate potential compliance, quality of care, patient safety, or regulatory issues appropriately

**Network Access & Care Navigation**

* Identify access-to-care concerns and potential network adequacy issues
* Assist members in locating participating providers and obtaining timely appointments
* Escalate network access barriers in accordance with regulatory access standards
* Support members through complex care coordination and navigation needs

**Documentation & Communication**

* Manage high-volume inbound and outbound phone calls, emails, and written correspondence
* Accurately document all member and provider interactions in applicable systems
* Maintain detailed case notes while ensuring confidentiality of Protected Health Information (PHI)
* Follow approved communication standards while personalizing interactions to meet individual member needs

**Operational Excellence**

* Meet established quality, productivity, attendance, and service level expectations
* Demonstrate flexibility in a rapidly evolving healthcare environment
* Participate in ongoing training, coaching, and professional development
* Support continuous improvement initiatives designed to enhance the member and provider experience

  

**DESIRED PROFESSIONAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

  

* High School Diploma or equivalent; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred
* 2+ years of experience in a healthcare contact center, member services, or provider services role
* Working knowledge of health insurance operations including eligibility, benefits, claims, prior authorizations, referrals, and appeals/grievances processes
* Familiarity with CMS, TDI, NCQA, and HIPAA compliance requirements as they relate to member and provider services
* Proficiency with EMR and payer portal systems; experience with Athena a plus
* Exceptional customer service, communication, and active listening skills
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate multiple systems simultaneously
* Ability to manage high call and case volume while maintaining accuracy and compassion
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams
* Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline
* Preferred: Experience in a payvider, integrated delivery system, or health plan environment
* Preferred: Familiarity with Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, ACA Marketplace, or employer group insurance products
* Preferred: Experience handling appeals, grievances, or regulatory complaint processes
* Preferred: Knowledge of medical terminology, CPT/ICD-10 coding, or claims adjudication
* Preferred: Bilingual in English/Spanish

  

**WHAT WE OFFER**

  

* Competitive salary and incentives
* Generous PTO
* 10 paid holidays
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Investment Plan
* Company Equity
* Professional development and growth opportunities

  

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

  

At Harbor Health, we're transforming healthcare in Texas through collaboration and innovation. We're seeking passionate individuals to help us create a member-centered experience that connects comprehensive care with a modern payment model. If you're ready to make a meaningful impact in a dynamic environment where your contributions are valued, please bring your talents to our team!

  

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT**

  

Harbor Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

**\*Candidates must reside within a two (2) hour radius of Toms River, NJ, Red Bank, NJ or Uniondale, NY and must be a resident of New Jersey, New York, or Pennsylvania\***

At OceanFirst Bank, each one of our employees plays an important role in delivering value to our customers and executing daily tasks in accordance with our core values. We recognize that our employees are essential to our success, making OceanFirst a great place to work and do business.

Apply today to #BecomeOceanFirst and make an impact in the local community!

**About the Role**

The Customer Care Associate position is a customer service ambassador to external and internal customers of the Bank. This position provides and ensures professional decorum to internal and external customers at all times, while responding to calls, emails and chats presented in the Call Center.

**What You Will Do**

* Answers incoming customer requests through telephone, chat and email and assists customers and staff with banking related questions. Responds professionally and treats customers and staff with respect at all times.

* Tracks case interactions through the Salesforce CRM platform.

* Understands and initiates use of video technology to assist customers face to face when needed; Maintains a thorough understanding of the Bank's products and services and presents alternate banking solutions to customers when appropriate.

* Effectively handles issues and complaints, makes appropriate decisions using Bank policy and procedures, and escalates issues to management when appropriate.

* Assists with department tasks, review of the mobile deposit queue, operating the ITM platform, survey responses, social media monitoring, research and maintenance requests as needed.

* Supports Online Banking customers via telephone and Live Chat, including the explanation of features and functionality, browser compatibility, troubleshooting, adding accounts and password resets.

* Provides debit card decline support and unblocks cards for travelers as requested.

* Assists customers with lost or stolen debit cards including placing the card in "Hot Card" status, reviewing recent transactions to identify fraudulent activity, initiating Reg E claims when necessary.

* Maintains knowledge of the Bank's security standards and reports incidents appropriately.

* Performs approved account maintenance in accordance with policy and procedure.

* May assist with conversion related and special projects as needed.

* May be required to assist with opening and closing of the branch, settlement and the processing of Teller transactions as needed.

Requirements:

**What We Expect of You**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and proficiency with video chat.
* Strong customer service skills.
* Ability to solve complex problems quickly and efficiently.
* Strong computer literacy (including Internet, PC and E-mail technology) and ability to navigate multiple programs simultaneously while speaking with a customer.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.
* Knowledge of operating in a financial services environment and its policies and procedures.
* Working knowledge of bank products and services or ability to be trained and quickly learn.
* Availability to work extended hours and weekends.

**Your Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum one year experience in customer service / call center environment.
* Experience preferred working with:
* CCaas Solutions (Nice, Five9, Talkdesk, Genesys, etc.)
* Cloud-based CRM (Salesforce, MS Dynamics, etc.)

**Internal and External Contacts**

* Frequent divisional and interdivisional contact.
* Frequent contact with customers in response to inquiries on all account related issues.
* Occasional contact with external providers.

**Working Conditions/Physical Requirements**

Remote environment. If working remotely environment must be noise and distraction free. Ability to operate computer. Ability to communicate in order to exchange simple to complex information with individuals and groups. Ability to travel throughout Bank footprint.

90f84b28fe834f907654.title: Inside Sales Representative
90f84b28fe834f907654.description:
Aspen Publishing is seeking an **Inside Sales Representative** to be a part of a growing Sales team. This position is 100% remote and Representative will ideally be located in their territory. You will be partnering with internal and external Aspen stakeholders and you will be critical to the continued expansion of new business by conducting virtual meetings, presentations, sales calls, and emails.  
  
**TITLE**: **Inside Sales Representative**  
**REPORTS TO**: Channel Sales Director  
**DEPARTMENT**: SALES  
**FLSA STATUS**: NON-EXEMPT  
**LOCATION**: Remote (Mid-West)  
**SALARY RANGE:** $60.1K MIN/ **$77.9K MID**/ $97.1K MAX  
  
**POSITION SUMMARY**: Generate new academic sales and retain existing sales in assigned territory; develop and qualify prospect lists from undergraduate legal faculty, deans, administrators, and program chairs; increase new business through virtual meetings, presentations, sales calls, and emails.  
  
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Achieve annual territory sales goals
* Generate leads and close sales for adoptable electronic and print publications with undergraduate school faculty
* Engage in sales activities to schools within territory and present product solutions of our textbook, digital, and institutional products
* Drive new business to develop growth within the territory
* Maintain current business and provide support to customers
* Master print and electronic product content for Aspen Publishing and competition titles, and share market intelligence and sales techniques with colleagues
* Explain concepts clearly and adapt presentations to meet audience needs
* Submit weekly sales activity reports, including projections of adopted business
* Update and maintain faculty and bookstore contact management system, including information on courses taught and books used
* Ensure timely and accurate submissions of sales reporting and metrics
* Participate in biannual sales meetings, as well as external conferences as directed
* Build strong relationships with Aspen Publishing purchase influencers, including Academic Deans, Academic Support coordinators, Registrars, authors, and faculty
* Maintain accurate opportunity pipeline, account, and contact information, and record all sales activity in CRM
* Other duties as assigned

  
**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business or related field preferred
* 2+ years of Inside Sales experience preferably in legal and/or academic sales
* Ability to work with CRM to manage and maintain an accurate customer data base, Zoho a plus
* Ability to demo online technology products virtually
* Ability to explain concepts clearly and adapt presentations to meet audience needs
* Ability to manage a large client base across a large geographic territory
* Consistent achievement of sales quotas
* Expertise in Microsoft Office, in particular Excel, PowerPoint, and Word required
* Proactive self-starter with hands-on approach
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both oral and written
* Must have excellent organizational and time management skills
* Ability to work quickly and accurately in a fast paced, changing environment
* Ability to meet deadlines in a consistent and accurate manner
* Driven to succeed and motivated by a target driven environment
* Demonstrated ability in working independently and as part of a team

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to sit and stand for extended periods of time
* Ability to work on computer for extended periods of time
* Ability to listen and speak carefully while interacting with others

**ABOUT US:** Aspen Publishing, a UWorld Company, is a leading provider of educational content and digital learning solutions to law schools in the US and around the world. Aspen provides best-in-class solutions for legal education through authoritative textbooks written by renowned authors and breakthrough products such as Connected eBooks, Connected Quizzing, and PracticePerfect. Our JD-Next Program, which includes an online course and high-stakes law school admissions test delivered multiple times per year, is designed to support aspiring law students through high-quality test preparation and academic resources.  
  
The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. Aspen considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.  
  
In addition to competitive compensation, we offer a wide array of benefits including your choice of health and dental plans, generous paid time off and holidays, 401k with employer match, and an array of voluntary programs to cover all of life’s eventualities, from accidents to critical illness and pet insurance.  
  
EOE disability/veteran

Aspen Publishing is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resumes submitted outside of an active agreement with the Company.

384ed6f6e8ef0297f6c9.description:
Position: Training Program Coordinator CO+I Physical Security Training Program Coordinator

Reports To: Global Training and Development Manager

Location: Remote or Bellevue, WA

FLSA: Non-Exempt

Salary: 85K

DOE

**Summary**

The Training Program Coordinator provides high-level administrative support for the Datacenter Physical Security training team to ensure goals and objectives are accomplished in accordance with established priorities, timelines, and required specifications. This role acts as the main Learning Management System (LMS) administrator, liaison for training data reporting accuracy, and responding to or directing messages in the Training and Development email inbox. The role is highly collaborative in nature offering support to multiple work groups during core business hours.

**Essential Functions**

Acts as the primary owner and manager of the Physical Security Training (PSTRN) mailbox.

Acts as an administrator in the learning management system (LMS) and related systems, using understanding of system interactions to streamline tasks and provide training and guidance to other team members who use the systems.

Supports Instructional Design team by reviewing a variety of process documents, job aids, templates, and checklists.

Supports Training and Development team in training scheduling and logistics.

Supports AMER Regional Training and Development Manager in conducting annual reviews of Training-related documents in partnership with stakeholders; identifies opportunities for process improvement.

Coordinates LMS on-boarding and off-boarding processes to include notification of site leadership of action items; ensures employees are added or removed from the necessary training systems.

Owns, updates, and audits reporting mechanisms for Training & Development; works with BI team members, training team members and Field Training Officers (FTO) to update and maintain Training Dashboards.

Manages projects for any annual conferences for the Training and Development team.

About Us:

Cooper Norcross Health, formerly Cooper University Health Care, is a leading academic health system affiliated with Cooper Medical School of Rowan University. Headquartered in Camden, New Jersey, Cooper Norcross Health has revenues of more than $3 billion and an A+ credit rating from both S&P and Fitch Ratings.

Cooper Norcross Health has nearly 14,000 team members, including more than 2,200 nurses, more than 1,200 employed physicians representing 95 specialties and subspecialties, and more than 700 advanced practice providers.

The health system operates MD Anderson Cancer Center at Cooper as well as four hospitals – its 663-bed flagship Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden, its 229-bed Cooper Norcross University Hospital Cape Regional in Cape May Court House, Children’s Hospital at Cooper Norcross Health in Camden, and The Recovery Village Cherry Hill at Cooper, a substance abuse rehabilitation and inpatient treatment facility, in partnership with Advanced Recovery Systems.

Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden is the only Level 1 Trauma Center in South Jersey and the busiest in the region. The hospital has been recognized as a top-performing regional hospital by U.S. News & World Report’s Best Hospitals annual survey for eight years.

More than 2.54 million patients visit Cooper Norcross Health facilities annually. Its ambulatory network encompasses three outpatient surgery centers, seven urgent care centers, a wound care center, and more than 130 physician, physical therapy, and radiology offices extending from the Delaware River to the New Jersey shore.

Cooper Norcross Health, a not-for-profit health system, was named one of America’s Best Large Employers for 2026 by Forbes, ranking among the top 200 in the nation. Visit CooperHealth.org(opens in new window) to learn more.

Short Description:

The Patient Service Representative will be a resource to the department, patients, families, and health care team members within the scope of their role.

They will support the administrative and scheduling needs of the Innovative Delivery Programs including Population Health at Home, Remote Patient Monitoring, Complex and Transitional Care, and other population health programs/initiatives as needed.

1. Answers and fields phone calls and voice mail messages, monitors assigned front desk pools, documents events in patients digital health record, and escalates as appropriate.  
2. Faxes, scans PHI into their digital health record, and sorts mail.  
3. Schedules and confirms patient appointments and performs check-in, check-out.  
4. Prepares patient charts and information prior to scheduled appointment.  
5. Facilitates activation of patient’s MyChart account if not active  
6. Supports patient screening for digital remote patient monitoring (RPM) program eligibility (i.e. social, digital capabilities) and facilitates digital RPM program enrollment  
7. Orders/ships digital remote monitoring devices and confirms patient receipt.  
8. Anticipates problems or issues and solves within the scope of responsibility.  
9. Reviews digital RPM patient agreement and ensures signed.  
10. Collaborates with patients, care givers, providers, and other health care team members.  
11. Maintains privacy and confidentiality for all patients.  
12. Regularly attends in-services to further develop position and department.  
13. Performs all related duties or special projects as assigned/required.

The above are guidelines for the position but are not necessarily a delineation of all the actions/duties necessary to the job.

* Proficiency in patient registration, scheduling, medical insurance pre-certifications, authorizations and referrals preferred.
* Epic experience preferred.
* Excellent organizational, written/verbal communication and teamwork skills.
* Demonstrated performance of excellent customer service skills.

High School Diploma or equivalent required.

Special Requirements:

* Customer service oriented attitude/behavior as well as a pleasant and poised demeanor and excellent phone etiquette.
* Must possess excellent communication skills both verbal and written. Must be skilled in the use of computers.
* NAHAM Certified Healthcare Access Associate (CHAA) certification preferred.

**Customer Service Administrator | Dealership Sales, Finance, Titles & Office Support | $18–$25/hr | Hatfield, PA | Same-Day Offer for the Right Candidate**

Tigon Golf Carts is hiring a detail-oriented Customer Service Administrator for our Hatfield headquarters. This hands-on role blends customer service, inbound and outbound sales calls, service scheduling, vehicle title and registration paperwork, customer financing, accounts payable, and special projects that support all 15 of our locations. It's a great fit for a customer service representative, dealership office administrator, title clerk, finance or F&I assistant, accounting clerk, administrative assistant, or office manager who thinks critically, stays organized, and likes owning a project from start to finish.

The office is an easy commute from Lansdale, North Wales, Souderton, Telford, Harleysville, Montgomeryville, Colmar, Chalfont, Doylestown, Quakertown, Horsham, and Norristown.

**About Tigon Golf Carts**  
Tigon Golf Carts is a fast-growing golf cart dealership with 15 locations and counting, headquartered in Hatfield. We sell and service new, used, and custom golf carts, street-legal LSVs (low-speed vehicles), utility carts, and electric and lithium-powered models. Most of our customers aren't on a golf course: they're homeowners, communities, campgrounds, and businesses. Our standard is simple: *Every Cart Earns Its Stripes.*

**Schedule**  
Full-time, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM, Monday through Saturday. Saturday availability is required, with a consistent day off each week. Overtime is paid at time-and-a-half over 40 hours.

**What You'll Do**

*Customer Service & Sales*

* Handle inbound and outbound sales calls, qualify leads, and follow up with customers to close sales
* Answer service calls, schedule repair appointments, and coordinate with store service teams
* Resolve customer concerns professionally, including difficult conversations with customers and vendors
* Collect payments and follow up on outstanding balances

*Titles, Registration & Financing*

* Prepare and process vehicle titles, registrations, tags, and sales paperwork, including PennDOT and out-of-state documents
* Help customers complete financing and credit applications, and track deals through lender approval and funding
* Review deal paperwork for accuracy and completeness before submission

*Accounting & Clerical*

* Process accounts payable, pay vendor bills, and handle refunds and returns
* Perform accurate data entry and keep records current in our dealer management system (DMS) and spreadsheets
* Manage filing, document scanning, email, and general office administration

*Special Projects & Problem Solving*

* Take ownership of special projects from HQ leadership, such as process improvements, data clean-up, reporting, audits, and new store support
* Research problems, identify root causes, and recommend practical solutions
* Work with limited supervision, set priorities, and meet deadlines across several projects at once
* Partner with store managers and HQ departments to keep operations moving across all locations

**Requirements**

* 2+ years of experience in dealership finance, title processing, accounting, or a finance-related office role
* Experience in customer service, sales, or a phone-heavy office position
* Strong clerical skills: fast, accurate data entry, organized filing, and careful attention to detail
* Proficient with Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook, or Google Workspace
* Critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently on detailed or repetitive tasks without losing accuracy
* Clear, professional phone and written communication
* Able to work 9:00 AM–5:00 PM, Monday through Saturday, 40+ hours per week

**Preferred**

* Automotive, powersports, RV, marine, or golf cart dealership office experience
* PennDOT title and registration experience
* F&I, lender portal, or deal funding experience
* Accounts payable or bookkeeping experience
* Dealer management system (DMS) or CRM experience
* Project coordination or process improvement experience

**Pay & Benefits**

* $18 – $25 per hour, based on experience
* Commission
* Overtime pay at time-and-a-half over 40 hours
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* 401(k) retirement plan (launching December 22, 2026, with a 30-day enrollment period)
* Career growth with an expanding 15-location dealership group
* Same-day job offer for the right candidate

*Related roles: Customer Service Administrator, Customer Service Representative, Office Administrator, Dealership Office Administrator, Office Coordinator, Title Clerk, Tag and Title Clerk, Finance Assistant, F&I Assistant, Accounting Clerk, Accounts Payable Clerk, Sales Representative, Administrative Assistant, Project Coordinator*

*Tigon Golf Carts is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the hiring process.*

Pay: $18.00 - $25.00 per hour

* Employee discount
* Health insurance

* Which of these have you done in a past job? Vehicle title and registration paperwork / Customer financing or credit applications / Accounts payable or bill pay / None of these.

bcf534f777d2341f9bc5.description:
**Customer Support Representative**
===================================

Parsley Health · Member Experience · Remote US, Pacific Time schedule · Full-time

**About Parsley Health**
------------------------

Parsley Health is rebuilding primary care around root-cause, whole-person medicine. Our members get board-certified clinicians, health coaches, advanced testing, and a care platform that connects the dots across all of it.

We are a mostly virtual medical practice with care available across the country, and we recently expanded in-network access nationwide. As we grow, we're focused on making care more accessible and delivering a seamless, supportive experience for our members throughout their health journeys.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Customer Support Representative on our Member Experience team, you'll be a key point of contact for Parsley Health members, helping them navigate their care and ensuring they feel supported every step of the way.

You'll respond to member inquiries across phone, SMS, and our online messaging platform, assist with onboarding, scheduling, billing and membership questions, manage cancellation requests, and resolve concerns with empathy and professionalism.

You'll work closely with our clinical, care coordination, and sales teams to help deliver a positive member experience and ensure questions and concerns are addressed promptly.

**Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* **Member support:** Provide prompt, accurate, and empathetic responses to member inquiries across phone, SMS, and our online messaging platform.
* **Issue resolution:** Take ownership of member questions and concerns from initial contact through resolution, following up as needed and escalating complex issues to the appropriate team.
* **Member onboarding and navigation:** Help new members get started with Parsley, including onboarding calls, appointment scheduling, member portal navigation, and basic troubleshooting.
* **Membership and retention:** Answer questions about membership benefits, renewals, and cancellations. Help members understand the value of continued care and support retention efforts while respecting their decisions.
* **Billing and insurance support:** Assist members with general billing, payment, and insurance-related questions, including identifying concerns and connecting members with the appropriate billing or internal teams for resolution.
* **Cross-functional collaboration:** Partner with clinicians, care coordinators, and other internal teams to help resolve member needs and support a positive care experience.
* **Member feedback and improvement:** Identify recurring questions, concerns, and opportunities to improve the member experience. Share feedback and participate in team initiatives to improve service quality and member satisfaction.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* At least 1 year of experience in a customer service, client support, or patient-facing role, ideally involving direct phone and written communication.
* A genuinely empathetic and service-oriented approach that helps members feel heard, respected, and cared for.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence handling member concerns and resolving difficult conversations over the phone.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple inquiries and follow through on outstanding issues.
* A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and comfort taking ownership of your work.
* Ability to learn new systems, processes, and healthcare concepts quickly.
* Comfort handling sensitive member information and maintaining confidentiality in accordance with HIPAA and company policies.
* Openness to feedback, coaching, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, with a quiet, private workspace suitable for member calls.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience in healthcare, telehealth, health technology, or a startup environment.
* Experience with customer support or call management platforms such as Help Scout or JustCall.
* Familiarity with healthcare billing, insurance, or membership-based services.
* Experience supporting customer retention, renewals, or cancellation conversations.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

Parsley Health is committed to providing an equitable, fair, and transparent compensation program for all employees.

The starting compensation for this role is $24.25 p/hr ($50,440 annually, based on a 40-hour workweek).
  
  
We take a geo-neutral approach to compensation within the US, meaning that we pay based on job function and level, not location.

Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including experience level, skillset, scope, and internal equity relative to peers at the company.

### **Benefits include**

* Equity stake for all employees based on role level
* 401(k) + employer matching program
* Remote-first work environment
* Complimentary Parsley Health Complete Care membership
* Subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance plan options
* Generous flexible time off (FTO) plan
* Annual professional development stipend
* Annual wellness stipend

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
-------------------------------

At Parsley Health we believe in celebrating everything that makes us human and are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We embrace diversity and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

The more inclusive we are, the better we can serve our members.

**Important note**
------------------

In light of the recent increase in hiring scams, if you're selected to move onto the next phase of our hiring process, a member of our Talent Acquisition team will reach out to you directly from an **@parsleyhealth.com** email address to guide you through our interview process.

Please note:

* We will never communicate with you via Microsoft Teams
* We will never ask for your bank account information at any point during the recruitment process
* We will never send you a check, electronic or physical, to purchase home office equipment

We look forward to connecting.

e996b4f9d72f56a34179.title: Team Manager, Partner Support
e996b4f9d72f56a34179.description:
**About the team**
------------------

Our Team Manager, Partner Support works directly with real estate professionals and internal business partners to provide consultation on Zillow's platform and build a better client experience. The team focuses on troubleshooting technical issues, handling billing inquiries, and educating partners on our products and services through inbound/outbound calls, chat, and email. We provide support Monday–Friday (5 am–5 pm PST) and Saturday–Sunday (6:30 am–5 pm PST).
  
  
Our mission in Partner Support is to anticipate our customers' needs during every conversation and contact, providing outstanding support and becoming an integral part of our partners' business. The successful candidate will uphold and actively contribute to achieving that mission.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Team Manager, Partner Support at Zillow, you will lead and empower a team of partner support consultants in a high-volume contact center environment. Reporting to the Partner Support Sr. Manager, you will drive day-to-day contact center operations — managing queue health, quality, and agent performance across inbound/outbound calls, chat, and email. You will also serve as a second-level technical resource and primary escalation point for partner-facing issues, with a focus on delivering outstanding, consistent support at scale.

  

**Your responsibilities will include**

* Empowering the team through performance coaching, career planning, and setting educational and performance objectives
* Providing direction, instructions, and mentorship to team members
* Leading the flow of remote day-to-day partner support operations
* Performing weekly quality monitor reviews for team members
* Documenting and addressing attendance or performance issues in a timely manner
* Serving as the primary point of contact for partner-related technical and customer escalations
* Participating in the hiring process for all department candidates
* Participating in workforce management planning for the organization
* Improving efficiency by identifying opportunities in agent performance, tools, training, processes, and employee engagement
* Reporting on operational and critical support metrics
* Partnering with the Partner Support Manager and Director to roll out departmental team initiatives in a fast paced environment.
* Fostering a culture of adaptability by modeling positive change management, communicating the "why" behind initiatives, and equipping the team to navigate and embrace evolving processes and priorities

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $73,200.00 - $116,900.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $69,500.00 - $111,100.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

**Who you are**
---------------

* 6+ years of experience in a customer experience, customer support, contact center, or operations role, including people-lead responsibilities such as coaching, assigning work, or acting as a team lead.
* Experience supervising or leading a team in a contact center or high-volume support environment
* Familiarity with contact center metrics, including average handle time, customer satisfaction, first contact resolution, and schedule adherence.
* Experience with workforce management, scheduling, and queue management practices preferred
* Background working in a fast-paced, remote contact center environment
* Associate's degree or higher in a Business field preferred but not required
* Passion for customer and partner happiness, with the ability to measure and track outcomes
* Strong communication skills across phone, chat, and email channels
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to develop and cultivate collaboration in a distributed team
* Ability to approach problems with a logical, structured, and detail-oriented mindset
* Openness to feedback and a drive for continuous improvement
* Excellent organizational skills; able to multi-task and prioritize in a fast-moving environment
* Ability to champion organizational change and bring the team along
* Strong digital literacy: proficiency with MS Office, contact center tooling, and reporting systems
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.  

  

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

  

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

  

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

  

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

  

*Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.*

  

*Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.*

  

*Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

Site: Mass General Brigham Community Physicians, Inc.

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

**Job Summary**

At Mass General Brigham Medical Group, our Call Center team serves as a vital connection between patients and care teams across the organization. Representatives provide compassionate, patient-centered support by assisting with appointment scheduling, registration, referral coordination, message management, and general inquiries across a wide range of specialties and practices. Using Mass General Brigham’s integrated systems and resources, the team helps ensure patients receive timely access to high-quality care while delivering an exceptional experience with every interaction.  
  
We are seeking a full-time, 40-hour Call Center Representative to join our team! This role will support our multidisciplinary team by handling a high volume of inbound calls, averaging approximately 70-90 calls per day, per agent. Responsibilities include scheduling appointments, answering questions, handling complaints, and troubleshooting problems. The goal is to ensure that our callers receive timely, efficient, and high-quality service!  
  
The ideal schedule for this role is Monday to Friday, from 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM.

40

2

The **Client Coordinator** is responsible for servicing inquiries from clients, physicians, nurses or any representative acting on behalf of a client. This position is responsible for data preparation, data entry, data tracking, documentation and filing. All duties are handled with a high degree of quality customer service and in compliance with all regulatory and company standards.

**Hours:** Monday-Friday 9am-5:30pm

**Location:** Remote

* Utilize appropriate systems and databases to enter client or claimant information and or retrieve information.
* Maintain daily contact with the QA department regarding workflow and pending report status.
* Contact providers for assignment and update database.
* File and archive open and closed cases.
* Verify all client information is current in the database and all client specific guidelines and or rules or information is documented in the system.

* Must be able to demonstrate and promote a positive team -oriented environment.

* Must possess the ability to manage change, delays, or unexpected events appropriately.
* Ability to follow all company policies and procedures in effect at time of hire and as they may change or be added from time to time.

**LANGUAGE/ COMMUNICATION SKILLS:**

* Ability to read, analyze and interpret common correspondence, medical records, and legal contracts and documents.
* Ability to write clearly and informatively to all required audiences and edit own work for appropriate spelling and grammar.
* Ability to respond appropriately and professionally to all inquiries or complaints from customers, physicians, regulatory agencies, and/or members of the business community.

be56f57a36a7cb359c6f.title: Clinical Specialist CRM - Jacksonville, FL
be56f57a36a7cb359c6f.description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 23 Nov 2026  
  

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

POSITION DESCRIPTION:
  
Provide technical, educational, operational and sales support to assist the district in meeting Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) sales and customer service objectives. CRM seeks collaborative candidates who will meet our customer expectations by striving without reserve for the greatest possible reliability and quality in our products, processes, and systems by being accountable, having a voice and acting promptly.
  
  
This role supports the Jacksonville territory and requires candidates to reside within the assigned area and travel regularly to customer accounts. Clinical Specialists must be available to support urgent customer needs and participate in weekend, holiday, and occasional after-hours coverage as business needs require. A valid driver's license, active auto insurance, and a driving record that meets company standards are required.
  
  
To find all Cardiac Rhythm Management Clinical Specialist roles available please use #crmcs in the key word search at Medtronic Careers  
  

The Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) portfolio delivers therapies designed to restore, support, and protect every heartbeat through advanced pacing, defibrillation, and remote monitoring solutions. CRM's unique ability to pair proven life-saving therapies with intelligent technology gives clinicians and patients greater confidence. Clinical impact and innovation come together to improve lives through meaningful patient outcomes.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

* **Provide** technical support for CRM devices and therapies by performing system checks/interrogations, supporting implants, troubleshooting issues, and applying knowledge gained through comprehensive CRM field training.
* **Coordinate** operational support by ensuring accurate patient documentation, managing inventory and equipment resources, maintaining programmer software, and assisting with daily coverage logistics to meet customer and business needs.
* **Educate** physicians, hospital staff, office personnel, and field team members on CRM products, therapies, and solutions, while supporting the onboarding and development of new Clinical Specialists and Sales Representatives.
* **Collaborate** with sales leadership and field partners to understand customer needs, market dynamics, and the value of Medtronic CRM products and solutions.
* **Identify** customer opportunities, support purchase order activities, monitor competitive trends, and provide actionable feedback to help achieve sales objectives.
* **Maintain** technical expertise by staying current on new CRM products, therapies, solutions, and patient management offerings to effectively support customers and clinical outcomes.
* **Travel** extensively within the assigned territory to support customer clinics, hospitals, and business meetings, with frequent independent driving – approximate 80% of the time
* **Perform** physical job requirements, including frequent two-handed lifting of up to **40 lbs.** , sitting, standing, and walking for **8+ hours per day** , and regularly bending, stooping, squatting, and maintaining balance.
* **Work** effectively in clinical environments with exposure to eye protection, infectious disease, and radiation, while wearing **7-9 lbs.** of lead for extended periods, utilizing computers and mobile devices, and maintaining the vision capabilities necessary to support patient care and field-based responsibilities.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* High School Diploma PLUS a minimum 6 years **OR** Associate’s Degree PLUS a minimum 4 years **OR** Bachelor’s Degree PLUS a minimum 2 years of work experience in healthcare, field sales, or work experience utilizing complex mathematics, mechanical concepts, science or computing

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
