53c813220e9a3556da7e.title: Inside Sales Manager
53c813220e9a3556da7e.description:
**Inside Sales Manager**
------------------------

**Learner Education | 100% Remote | Full-Time**

**Base Salary:** 90,000–105,000 annually

**Target Total Compensation:** 110,000–135,000, including performance-based bonuses

**About Learner**
-----------------

At Learner, we believe the right tutor can change a student's life.

We provide personalized, one-on-one online tutoring that helps students build confidence, overcome challenges, and achieve their academic goals.

We're a growing, entrepreneurial company with a team that cares deeply about our customers, our colleagues, and the impact we make.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We're looking for a hands-on, results-driven Inside Sales Manager who is passionate about developing people, improving sales performance, and building high-performing teams.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of our sales team's performance, work directly with our CEO, and make a measurable impact on both our team and the families we serve.

You'll play a key role in coaching sales representatives, improving conversion rates, strengthening processes, and creating a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

We're not looking for someone who simply monitors dashboards and runs meetings. We want someone who recognizes opportunities, solves problems, holds people accountable, and makes the entire team better.

You'll have the opportunity to shape our sales processes, leverage innovative AI tools, and build a high-performing team in a company where your contributions will be visible and meaningful.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Sales Performance & Growth**

* Own monthly sales targets and take responsibility for delivering results.
* Analyze sales performance, conversion rates, and pipeline metrics to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Proactively identify performance gaps, communicate concerns, and implement actionable solutions.
* Use data and measurable results to continuously improve team performance and sales effectiveness.

### **Coaching & Team Development**

* Conduct meaningful weekly 1:1 coaching sessions with every sales representative.
* Regularly review sales calls, provide actionable feedback, and track individual progress.
* Own onboarding and help new hires become productive quickly.
* Leverage AI-powered coaching tools to accelerate representative development.
* Recognize strong performance and address underperformance directly and constructively.

### **Sales Operations & Accountability**

* Ensure consistent execution of sales processes, including speed-to-lead, pipeline management, and prospect follow-up.
* Maintain high standards for CRM accuracy, sales activity, and accountability.
* Establish clear expectations, monitor execution, and follow through to ensure commitments are met.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve efficiency, and strengthen overall sales operations.

### **Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead with ownership, urgency, integrity, and transparency.
* Independently manage day-to-day sales operations, including routine client requests and team coverage needs.
* Recognize when larger performance, compensation, or operational issues require escalation to leadership.
* Collaborate closely with Marketing, Tutor & Client Support, Operations, and other departments.
* Foster a positive, supportive, and accountable team culture.
* Create an environment where sales representatives feel motivated, supported, and challenged to continuously improve.

  
**Requirements**  

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Approximately 3–5 years of experience managing and developing a sales team.
* A demonstrated track record of improving sales performance through effective coaching.
* Experience leading consultative sales teams, preferably in B2C, inside sales, or consumer-focused service environments.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate sales data into actionable improvements.
* Experience using CRM systems to manage pipelines, performance, and accountability.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* An entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive, hands-on leadership approach.
* Enthusiasm for adopting AI and emerging technologies to improve sales effectiveness.
* A genuine passion for developing people and building strong teams.

### **Nice to Have**

* Inside sales leadership experience.
* Experience in education, tutoring, or another consumer-focused service business.
* Familiarity with Pipedrive and/or AI-powered sales coaching tools.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

You'll be successful when:

* The team consistently meets or exceeds monthly sales goals.
* Conversion rates improve through effective coaching and sales execution.
* New hires become productive faster.
* Every representative receives consistent coaching and demonstrates measurable development.
* Performance challenges are identified and addressed proactively.
* Sales processes are followed consistently without requiring constant oversight.
* Other departments view Sales as a responsive, collaborative, and dependable partner.
* The team is engaged, accountable, and proud to be part of Learner.

  
**Benefits**  

**Work Environment & Compensation**
-----------------------------------

**This is a 100% remote, full-time leadership position reporting directly to Learner's CEO.**

You'll manage a team of sales representatives, focusing primarily on coaching, developing talent, improving processes, and driving team performance rather than carrying an individual sales quota.

**Schedule & Availability:** This role offers flexibility to manage your own schedule while remaining responsive to business needs across Learner Education's seven-day operating week. Candidates should be comfortable adjusting their availability, including evenings and weekends when necessary, to ensure the team has the support needed to succeed.

As a hands-on leader, you'll be expected to provide guidance, answer questions, and assist your team as needed. This may occasionally include stepping in to support sales calls during unexpected staffing gaps.

### **Compensation**

* **Base Salary:** 90,000–105,000 annually.
* **Target Total Compensation:** 110,000–135,000 annually, including performance-based bonus opportunities.
* **Performance-Based Bonuses:** Monthly bonus opportunities based on sales performance and leadership objectives.

### **Benefits & Perks**

* **Paid Time Off:** Unlimited
* **Health Benefits:** Access to health insurance benefits.
* **401(k) Retirement Plan:** Plan and save for your future.
* **Stock Options:** Opportunity to share in Learner's long-term growth and success.
* **100% Remote:** Work remotely with flexibility to manage your schedule.

**Why Join Learner?**
---------------------

* **Make a real impact:** Help families find the academic support their children need.
* **Own the results:** Have meaningful responsibility and the autonomy to improve performance.
* **Develop people:** Build a team where coaching and professional growth are priorities.
* **Embrace innovation:** Work with AI and modern sales technology to improve how we operate.
* **Be part of a great culture:** Join colleagues who value teamwork, transparency, accountability, and celebrating each other's success.

**We're looking for someone who doesn't just want to manage a sales team.**

We want someone who wants to build a great one.

314262f6fab662e3e44c.title: Modesto Remote MediCal Call Center Agent
314262f6fab662e3e44c.description:
Description:

Join Fortuna as a full-time Medi-Cal Call Center Agent, supporting members and providers in a high-volume inbound phone environment. This position is designed for experienced healthcare call center professionals who are comfortable working within structured procedures, navigating multiple computer systems, researching information independently, and meeting closely monitored performance expectations. The anticipated training start date is 1.4.2027.

This is a phone-based position with no email or chat interaction for members.

Candidates must reside in California. If you are having technical or internet issues that prevent you from working remotely, you will be required to drive into Sacramento and work from the office.

You will be required to pass a typing assessment scoring a minimum of 30 words per minute and 95% accuracy.

**Worksite:** Remote; must reside in CA.

**Work hours:** Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. or 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.

**Compensation:** $19.50 per hour upon successful completion of the 4-week training. Training pay rate is $19.00 per hour.

**Training:** Starting on January 4, 2027, there will be 4 weeks of paid, remote training, Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. PST

**What We Offer:**

* Four weeks of comprehensive paid training
* Company-provided laptop and required accessories
* Benefits available after a 90-day waiting period
* A structured, full-time schedule
* Ongoing coaching and performance feedback

**What You'll Do:**

* Complete a 4-week remote training program with reliable attendance and active participation.
* Handle a continuous volume of inbound Medi-Cal member and provider calls.
* Respond to member and provider questions accurately, professionally, and efficiently.
* Use an internal Wiki to research policies, procedures, and approved responses while assisting members.
* Navigate multiple systems and applications while maintaining an active phone conversation.
* Document every caller interaction clearly and accurately.
* Follow established call procedures, scripts, verification requirements, and escalation protocols.
* Resolve member concerns whenever possible or escalate issues through the appropriate channels.
* Protect confidential information and follow all privacy and security requirements.
* Consistently meet performance expectations for average handle time, schedule adherence, attendance, call quality, documentation accuracy, and other assigned KPIs.
* Accept coaching and apply feedback to improve performance.

**Important Expectations Before Applying**

This position may not be a good fit for individuals seeking email, chat, or non-phone customer service work. Agents will spend the majority of their workday handling inbound calls in a closely monitored environment.

Attendance during the 4-week training program is critical. Continued employment will depend on completing training and consistently meeting expectations for attendance, schedule adherence, call handling time, quality, accuracy, and overall performance.

**About Fortuna**

Fortuna operates as a staffing agency that sources, screens, and presents qualified candidates for employment opportunities on behalf of our clients.

www.gofortuna.com

Requirements:

**What You'll Bring:**

***This remote position is restricted to California residents only.***

* At least six months of recent, high-volume inbound call center experience; one year or more is strongly preferred.
* A minimum of six months of professional healthcare experience is preferred. Relevant experience may include health insurance, Medi-Cal or Medicaid, medical scheduling, patient or member services, claims, benefits, eligibility, authorizations, provider services, or other healthcare support.
* Experience working in a performance-driven call center where average handle time, schedule adherence, attendance, and QA scores were regularly measured.
* Demonstrated employment reliability and the ability to clearly explain the reason for leaving each recent position, including short-term or contract assignments.
* Strong basic computer skills, including the ability to:
  + Navigate multiple applications simultaneously
  + Switch efficiently between screens and browser tabs
  + Search an internal Wiki or knowledge base
  + Copy and paste information accurately
  + Upload, download, and locate files
  + Use Microsoft Outlook, Teams, and other Microsoft 365 applications
  + Resolve basic connectivity, audio, and application issues
* Ability to research, interpret, and apply written healthcare policies and procedures while assisting a member.
* Typing speed of at least 30 WPM with 95% accuracy.
* Strong verbal communication, active listening, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to remain professional and composed during repetitive, complex, or challenging member calls.
* A record of dependable attendance, punctuality, and schedule adherence.
* Ability to accept coaching and consistently apply performance feedback.
* High school diploma or GED.
* Reliable internet service with a minimum download speed of 50 Mbps.
* A private, quiet, and distraction-free home workspace appropriate for confidential healthcare member calls.
* Bilingual in Spanish is a plus.

9b3aac0733ee747e4349.title: Senior Luxury Furniture Sales Specialist
9b3aac0733ee747e4349.description:
**About Us**

Arditi Collection® is an international luxury furniture brand specializing in bespoke, made-to-order furniture for high-end residential, commercial, and hospitality projects throughout North America.

We are seeking an experienced, results-driven Senior Luxury Furniture Sales Specialist with a proven background in high-ticket sales, consultative selling, client relationship management, and closing deals.

The ideal candidate understands the expectations of luxury clientele and can independently manage high-value sales opportunities from initial inquiry through order placement.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage inbound sales inquiries through phone, email, live chat, and online quote requests.
* Conduct daily sales calls and proactive follow-ups with prospective clients.
* Understand client needs, design preferences, material selections, budgets, and project requirements.
* Prepare, present, revise, and follow up on customized sales proposals and quotations.
* Negotiate effectively, handle objections, and convert qualified inquiries into confirmed orders.
* Build and maintain relationships with interior designers, architects, developers, procurement firms, and other trade professionals.
* Identify new business opportunities through proactive outreach and prospecting.
* Manage multiple sales opportunities and maintain an organized sales pipeline.
* Collaborate closely with our design and production teams throughout the sales process.
* Achieve established sales targets and contribute to revenue growth.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of 5 years of professional, direct sales experience.
* Proven experience in high-ticket product or project sales.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong consultative selling, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
* Confidence in conducting phone-based sales conversations and proactive client follow-ups.
* Ability to independently manage the full sales cycle.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Professional communication skills appropriate for luxury clientele.
* Self-motivated, accountable, and results-oriented.
* Ability to work independently in a full-time remote environment.
* Currently based in the United States and legally authorized to work in the United States.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

Direct sales experience in one or more of the following industries is strongly preferred:

* Luxury furniture and bespoke furnishings
* High-end interior furnishings and home décor
* Luxury kitchens and custom cabinetry
* Premium architectural products
* Luxury lighting
* Marble and natural stone
* Premium home and lifestyle products
* Luxury real estate
* High-end residential and hospitality projects
* Furniture, fixtures, and equipment (FF&E)

Experience working with interior designers, architects, trade accounts, and both B2B and B2C luxury clients is highly desirable.

A background in interior design, architecture, or furniture is an advantage but does not replace professional sales experience.

**Work Arrangement**

* Full-time
* Fully remote
* United States based
* North American business hours

**Important Information**

This is a dedicated sales position, not an interior design, architecture, furniture design, customer service, or sales support role.

We are looking for an accomplished sales professional who takes ownership of sales opportunities, actively engages with clients, and demonstrates a proven ability to close high-value deals.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your current resume through Indeed.

Your resume should clearly outline your professional sales experience, industry background, products or services sold, responsibilities, and measurable sales achievements where available.

Applications without a resume or relevant direct sales experience will not be considered.

All applications must be submitted through Indeed.

Arditi Collection® is committed to equal employment opportunities and evaluates candidates based on their professional qualifications, relevant experience, and ability to perform the role.

Work Location: Remote

6d6294a014496ef647b9.title: Associate Underwriter, Workers Compensation
6d6294a014496ef647b9.description:
We’re thrilled that you are interested in joining us here at the Amynta Group!

This position is a customer-focused Associate Underwriter role responsible for managing workers' compensation renewals, servicing agents and insureds, processing policy transactions, and supporting underwriting operations while working in a fast-paced remote environment.

At BTIS “**Be Great**” isn’t just our motto — it’s how we show up every day. As a leading commercial insurance MGA, we’re committed to delivering excellence to our retail agency partners and building strong, collaborative relationships with our carrier partners.

ac89c05a313bbf495b23.title: Account Manager, Enterprise
ac89c05a313bbf495b23.description:
### **About Us**

Scorpion is the leading provider of technology and services helping local businesses thrive. We do this by helping customers understand local market dynamics, make the most of their marketing, and deliver experiences their customers will love. We offer tools to know what's going on with marketing, competitors, and customers. We offer a unique blend of AI support and teams of real human people with local expertise committed to customer success. At Scorpion, we are ready to do whatever it takes to help our clients reach their goals. Our technology and personalized tools bring everything together to help local businesses easily understand their unique business, market, and customer needs. We put SEO, Reviews, Advertising, Email Marketing, Chat and Messaging, Social Media, Website, Lead Management, Appointment Scheduling, and more to work for local businesses. We're a technology-led service with a human touch.

### **About the Role**

The Account Manager builds and maintains strong client relationships while serving as the primary point of contact between clients and internal teams. This role translates client objectives into strategic, results-driven marketing initiatives across SEO, paid advertising, social media, and other digital channels. The Account Manager ensures the effective execution of campaigns that align with client goals and deliver measurable outcomes. Through strong communication, strategic insight, and attention to detail, this role helps clients achieve online success and contributes directly to Scorpion's overall performance and growth.

### **What your success will look like**

* Client Relationship Management: Develop and maintain strong, long-lasting client relationships by understanding their needs, objectives, and business goals.
* Account Strategy: Develop and implement comprehensive digital marketing strategies in collaboration with our internal teams, encompassing SEO, paid advertising, social media management, chat, and content marketing, to achieve client objectives.
* Account Reviews: Monitor and analyze campaign performance, providing insights and recommendations for improvements to clients, covering SEO, PPC, and social media KPIs.
* New Business Development: Identify opportunities for upselling and expanding our services within existing client accounts.
* Team Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams, including the Directors, SEO specialists, paid advertising experts, social media managers, and content writers, to ensure client success.
* Budget Management: Manage client budgets, ensuring efficient allocation of resources to achieve campaign objectives and return on investment.

### **Who you are and what you bring**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, Communications, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience:
  + 2+ year of professional experience in client-facing account management.
  + Proven track record of upselling and growing client accounts.
  + Proven ability to manage client relationships, understand their needs, and deliver results.
  + Experience working with cross-functional teams to execute client strategies.
* Skills  
  + Understanding of digital marketing channels, strategies, and tactics, including SEO, social media, and paid advertising
  + Excellent attention to detail, with a keen understanding of budget constraints and project management
  + Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills to foster trust with clients.
  + A proactive approach to problem-solving and managing client expectations.
  + Ability to multitask, prioritize, and perform well under pressure.
  + Eagerness to learn new tools, platforms, and industry best practices.

### **Our Scorpion Values**

**Winning Mindset:** When our clients win, we win.  
**Genuine Care:** We only succeed when we are truly invested in our clients and each other.  
**Unmatched Results:** We deliver more than expected–and then some–driving the best results and impacting lives.  
**Constant Improvement:** We believe there is always a better way. We learn we ask "What if?" we build and then do it again.  
**Unbeatable Teamwork:** We come from different backgrounds but have the same vision. We only get there by doing it together, as a team.

### **Compensation**

We acknowledge that states have passed legislation promoting pay transparency. As a national employer, Scorpion has made the decision to post our expected pay rate or pay range (as applicable) in all our job postings, regardless of geographic location.

* The base salary range is $60,000 (entry-level) - $80,000 (highly experienced), exclusive of fringe benefits. If you are hired at Scorpion, your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience. Additionally, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider the internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above is the total salary range for the role. Hiring at the maximum of the range would not be typical in order to allow for future & continued salary growth.
* The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of discretionary bonuses or commissions.

### **Our Interview Process**

We value your time and want to give you the best opportunity to showcase your skills. Here's what to expect:

* **Initial Phone Screen (30 minutes)** – A conversation with a recruiter to learn more about you, share details about the role, and answer any questions you may have.
* **First Interview (30 minutes, Zoom)** – A discussion with the hiring manager to dive deeper into your experience, goals, and how they align with the role.
* **Second Interview (45 minutes, Zoom)** – A panel interview with key team members to assess your skills and how you'd collaborate with the team.
* **Final Interview (30 minutes, Zoom)** – A conversation with the department lead to discuss the broader vision and how you'd contribute to the team's success.

### **Our Benefits**

We invest in our employees by offering them diverse benefits from best-in-class carriers. These benefits provide enough choice and flexibility to keep our employees and their families healthy and happy—today and tomorrow.

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance benefits
* Flexible paid time off, so you can rest, relax, and recharge away from work
* Paid parental leave
* Paid cell phone and service
* Remote office allowance
* Professional development and development courses
* Regular manager check-ins to drive performance and career growth through Lattice

### **Work Location & Flexibility**

Scorpion supports a range of work arrangements, including in-office, hybrid, and remote roles. For positions designated as remote, employees who live within commuting distance of a Scorpion office may be asked to work from the office based on team needs, collaboration opportunities, or business priorities. Specific expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Scorpion is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, military/veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or physical or mental disability. We believe in creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion.

[Reasonable Accommodations]

  

**Applicant Privacy**

When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to Scorpion. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

**E-Verify**

Scorpion participates in the E-Verify program to confirm employment authorization of all newly hired employees. The E-Verify process is completed during new hire onboarding and completion of the Form I-9, Employment Eligibility Verification, at the start of employment. E-Verify is not used as a tool to pre-screen candidates. For more information on E-Verify, please visit www.uscis.gov.

80349ed5d9a8baa4f6e1.description:
**Candidate Authenticity Statement**  
We recognize that AI tools are increasingly used in professional settings. However, during our assessment and interview process, we ask candidates to complete all responses independently, without the use of AI-generated assistance.

This ensures we can accurately assess your individual skills, communication style, and problem-solving approach. Submissions or responses that appear AI-generated may be considered misaligned with our evaluation standards.

**Remote-First with In-Person Training:** This position is remote following successful completion of onboarding. New hires are required to attend two weeks of in-person training at our Carrollton, TX corporate office to ensure a smooth and successful transition into the role.

**Position Summary:**

1920954e8fdc49c41758.description:
**School Coordinator with Insite**
==================================

**Location:** Newton, NJ or Marlton, NJ  
**Salary:** $20.00–$23.00 per hour depending on experience  
**Job Type:** Full-Time/40 hours a week, W-2 with full benefits

**Comprehensive Benefits Include:**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Life Insurance
* Generous paid time off and holidays
* Employee referral program

**Who is InSite Health?**
-------------------------

InSite Health is a leading behavioral health organization partnering with several hundred schools to deliver best-in-class mental health programs for students. We are equally committed to supporting the employees who make this work possible by fostering a culture of care, collaboration, and shared purpose.  
  
We leverage proprietary technology and a collaborative care model to help districts identify, support, and manage student needs more effectively by integrating clinical services, data-driven insights, and streamlined workflows. This approach helps reduce symptoms in students, improve outcomes, decrease risk, and allow schools to operate more efficiently across their behavioral health programs.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The School Coordinator at InSite Health is responsible for coordinating and managing the scheduling and administrative processes associated with school-based services. This role serves as a key point of contact between families, schools, and clinical staff to facilitate timely appointments, maintain accurate scheduling records, and support the efficient delivery of services. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and committed to providing exceptional service to students, families, and school partners.

**Duties/Responsibilities**
---------------------------

* Coordinate and manage scheduling for school-based appointments, ensuring timely and accurate access to services for students and families.
* Conduct patient and family outreach, including appointment reminders, scheduling follow-ups, rescheduling, and responding to parent/guardian inquiries in a timely and professional manner.
* Coordinate clinician availability and scheduling needs to maximize appointment capacity and minimize wait times.
* Maintain accurate scheduling information and patient records within the electronic health record (EHR) system.
* Communicate with schools, families, and clinical staff regarding appointments, scheduling changes, and service-related updates.
* Identify and communicate scheduling conflicts, barriers, and workflow challenges to the Central Intake Manager.
* Support the resolution of scheduling issues and parent/guardian concerns by coordinating with the appropriate internal team members.
* Ensure all scheduling and communication activities adhere to HIPAA, FERPA, and applicable confidentiality standards.
* Track and maintain scheduling data and assist with preparing reports related to appointment access, scheduling activity, and workflow efficiency.
* Collaborate with the Central Intake and clinical teams to support consistent processes and improve the coordination of school-based services.
* Maintain organized documentation and follow established procedures to support efficient daily operations.

**Required Skills/Abilities**
-----------------------------

* Proficiency with electronic health record (EHR) systems and scheduling platforms.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a family-centered and service-oriented approach.
* Excellent organizational skills and a high level of attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to prioritize and multitask effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently manage day-to-day scheduling responsibilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) or related software.
* Knowledge of HIPAA, FERPA, and applicable privacy and confidentiality standards.
* Ability to adapt to new systems, processes, and changing operational needs.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively across departments.

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree in healthcare administration, education, or a related field preferred.
* 2+ years of experience in healthcare administration, school services, patient coordination, or administrative scheduling preferred.
* Experience working with electronic health records and coordinating appointments is preferred.

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Ability to lift up to 15 pounds as needed.

### ***St. Luke's is proud of the skills, experience and compassion of its employees. The employees of St. Luke's are our most valuable asset! Individually and together, our employees are dedicated to satisfying the mission*** ***of our organization which is an unwavering commitment to excellence as we care for the sick and injured; educate physicians, nurses and other health care providers; and improve access to care in the communities we serve, regardless of a patient's ability to pay for health care.***

The Manager, Practice Operations leads and manages the operations of assigned practices to ensure successful practice operations, effective execution of operational workflows, a patient experience consistent with SLPG standards, and a highly engaged practice operations team.

**JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Performs all leadership and managerial functions across the employee life cycle for direct reports including hiring, onboarding/orientation, performance management, ongoing coaching and development, recognition, etc.).
* Ensures operational readiness for clinical and administrative operations (e.g., developing employee schedules; maintaining supply inventory, office equipment and furnishings, cleanliness; facilitating daily huddles; updating time management systems; maintaining Point of Care licensing, etc.).

* Partners with other organizational functions (e.g., Billing/Coding, Facilities/Property Management, Hospital Entity departments, Access Center, etc.) to coordinate and facilitate effective practice operations.
* Maintains strong collaboration and connectivity with Access Center operations and centralized functions (e.g., POD, Capacity Management, etc.) to enable seamless operations and optimal patient/employee experiences (e.g., transfers, triage protocols, template changes, huddles, POD/practice connectivity, etc...).
* Serves as point of escalation and addresses critical operational, technological, patient, and employee issues.
* Achieves expected practice financial performance through judicious expense management, efficient resource utilization, volume growth, and execution of expected financial management best practices.
* Utilizes organizational tools to monitor practice performance (volume, patient satisfaction, productivity, quality, etc.), identifies opportunities for improvement, and develops/implements improvement strategies via a multidisciplinary, team-based approach.
* As applicable, effectively utilizes practice leads (e.g., Practice Operations Coordinators, Clinical Coordinators, etc.) to support oversight of practice workflows/processes, etc.

Rarely pushing and pulling patients weighing up to 300 pounds in a wheel chair or stretcher. Occasionally stooping and bending. Must be able to perceive attributes of an object through touch. Seeing as it relates to normal near, far, color, and peripheral vision. Hearing as it relates to normal conversation and high and low frequencies.

**EDUCATION:**

Bachelor’s Degree in health, business, or related field preferred

**TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Minimum of 2+ years of medical office or practice operations experience, including at least 1 year in a healthcare setting
* Experience managing or supporting daily operations such as staffing coordination, scheduling, patient access, workflow management, and regulatory compliance
* Demonstrated ability to supervise staff, support performance management, and maintain service and quality standards

Competencies required for this job:

* Strong business acumen
* Skilled in all forms of communication
* Effectively able to develop self and others
* Leadership presence/EQ, presents as a composed and competent leader
* Quality focused

* Shares a compelling strategy that inspires others

391c0d279fcf8cc92641.description:
**Description**

Penn Medicine is dedicated to our tripartite mission of providing the highest level of care to patients, conducting innovative research, and educating future leaders in the field of medicine. Working for this leading academic medical center means collaboration with top clinical, technical and business professionals across all disciplines.  
  
Today at Penn Medicine, someone will make a breakthrough. Someone will heal a heart, deliver hopeful news, and give comfort and reassurance. Our employees shape our future each day. Are you living your life's work?

**Clinical Services Associate (Medical Assistant)**

**Entity: (Clinical Care Associates) /Penn Primary Care (PPC) and Penn Specialty Practices (PSP)**

**Department: PSP Orthopaedics - CCH**

**Location: Penn Orthopaedics Exton- 479 Thomas Jones Way**

**Hours: Full Time**

**\*\*Please upload your Medical Assistant Diploma, Medical Assistant Certificate, and BLS certification card with application. \*\***

**Summary:**

The Clinical Services Associates (CSA) (MEDICAL ASSISTANT) assists the practice manager and physicians in maintaining a patient/customer focus, supports the delivery of high-quality care, shares a passion for patient and customer centered care, and assists in meeting or exceeding patient satisfaction and financial/operational targets. The CSA supports the practice by performing clinical and administrative duties as a Medical Assistant and as a Patient Services Associate. The practice will determine, based on operational need, how much time will be spent in each capacity (MA and PSA).

Are you looking for an organization that actively supports your career growth? If so, a Clinical Services Associate opportunity at Penn Medicine can help get you there! Clinical Services Associates have an opportunity to join our organization and make a difference in the lives of our patients. Clinical Services Associates with Penn Medicine are in a unique position to gain valuable knowledge which can be leveraged to move not only into more advanced clinical roles but also operational roles. Through our generous tuition benefit as well as our commitment to promoting from within Penn Medicine sees more than 30% of our employees secure advancement opportunities into roles such as a Clinical Services Coordinator, Nurses, and Practice Managers just to name a few!

Penn Medicine employees enjoy a comprehensive benefit package to include generous paid time off and paid holidays. And health insurance premiums which have remained flat for 5 years!

Want to hear more? Submit your application today for this Clinical Services Associate opportunity and learn more about what a career path at Penn Medicine could look like for you!

**Responsibilities:**

Patient Care Accountabilities:

* Promptly rooms patients, using EMR to alert provider that patient is ready: reviews past medical, surgical, family, smoking history, allergies, medications; notes corrections in EMR, notes medication refills needed for the physician to review, initiates self-management goal setting where appropriate, obtains patient’s vital signs and documents in EMR, prepares chart for patient visit, understands insurance restrictions for lab work, referral needs, precertification requirements, etc.
* Observes patient condition and communicates any abnormal data or changes to provider.
* Assist patients as needed with walking, transfers, dressing, undressing, preparing for the exam, remains in exam room when necessary/requested.
* Specimen management: obtain specimens for testing if applicable (including performing phlebotomy and anterior nares nasal swab collections), performs laboratory and screening tests, records results in EMR and reconciles with logs where appropriate, documents and reports findings to providers, performs all quality controls as per Point of Care Testing guidelines, prepares specimens for transport as necessary.
* Performs EKGs and other outpatient screening tests as per MD order and after properly preparing the patient; accurately documents results in EMR.
* Assists with minor surgical procedures by handing instruments, maintaining sterile field, positioning of patient and other duties within scope of responsibility. Functions as a witness for procedural consents if required.
* Responds appropriately to emergency/code situations.
* CCA CSAs, if applicable as per regulatory guidelines administers prescribed medications, gives injections and vaccines; reads PPD results, under the direction of the provider/orders and documents in EMR.
* Demonstrates competence in the observation, treatment, and care of the specific patients served in that practice, whose ages may range from neonate to geriatric.

Clerical / Other Accountabilities:

* Responsive and proactive telephonic patient care - including care coordination with specialists, ancillary services, hospitals, labs, home care agencies, and all other involved health services.
* Obtain and scan documents as appropriate and required for visit: test results, faxes, reports, notes, referrals, etc.
* Completes medical forms and other clinical requests for information as appropriate and required. Prepares and sends patient correspondence as required. Assists nursing staff with the maintenance of patient education materials, as needed.
* CCA CSAs: Promptly performs call-backs as directed by provider, giving patients information within their scope of practice. Provides patients with follow up care instructions.

Environmental / Safety Accountabilities:

* Adheres to universal body fluids precautions and infection control policies. Disposes of infectious waste properly. Promotes infection control by using appropriate hand washing techniques.
* Ensures that the patient care areas are kept neat, orderly, well stocked and properly prepared.
* Cleans, disinfects, and sterilizes instruments and equipment according to protocols and checks that the instruments and equipment are in proper working order. Notifies Supervisor of malfunctions. Sets up equipment and instruments as per practice protocol.
* Cleans and restocks equipment as needed. Authorized to access secured area to obtain items such as intravenous solutions and medication preparation supplies for the purpose of stocking and maintaining pars in the medication carts. Retrieves supplies and medications/blood products from tube system. Secures stock items in appropriate location. Delivers patient specific medications/blood products to the assigned nurse or provider.
* Maintain temperature log for refrigerator or room temperature as needed.
* Maintains a safe environment and protects the patient from injury by observing the patient who may be at risk for falls, confusion, disorientation, or wandering behaviors.
* CCA CSAs if applicable as per regulatory guidelines: Maintains medication storage closet inventory and security; checks expiration dates; removes outdated items. Performs daily code/crash cart checks as assigned.

Patient Service:

* Strives to understand and anticipate patient needs, manages service recovery efforts when needed, enlisting management assistance as appropriate, identifies opportunities to improve the patient experience.
* As per practice/department protocols and/or measurements: answer phones in a timely manner, manage/handle patient requests and route appropriately, retrieve voicemails in a timely manner, take accurate and thorough messages and route appropriately through EMR.
* Schedule patient appointments (on phone or in person) by determining reason for visit, following established schedules and protocols, using appropriate billing area/appointment location, communicating changes and confirming appointments, and as needed, offering alternative and canceling/rescheduling appointments.
* Responsible for arriving/departing activities of patient at practice and performs point of service activities collects copays and records accurately, obtains necessary signatures/forms, obtaining insurance cards and referrals/authorizations, updates appointment status in EMR, and finalizes all check-out procedures.
* Communicates with patients regarding patient flow and wait times – keeps manager aware of potential issues as they arise.
* Issues referrals and obtains pre-authorizations for patients as required and as per protocol.

Financial:

* Maintains up to date knowledge of insurance requirements pertinent to patient service and billing procedures: including basic knowledge of all managed care plans and which insurers require a copayment or referral.
* Validates patient demographic/insurance information and/or registers new patients into EMR using established protocols
* Records receipts accurately to ensure end of day reconciliation; participates in cash reconciliation delineations.
* Resolves work queues and/or issues from front-end reports; proactively prioritizes recovery of missing charges.
* Orders supplies for the office and generate front-end process reports as requested.

Other / Regulatory:

* Ensures compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local regulatory standards (ex TJC, DOH, FDA, HIPAA, HCFA, DPW, LCGME, SCGME, etc)
* Flexible and readily adopts new processes and engages in practice operation changes.

  

**Credentials:**

* BLS/CPR, as a healthcare provider per the American Heart Association Required
* MA Certification (Required within 90 days of hire ONLY if position is in PA. Must have at time of offer in NJ.)

Education or Equivalent Experience:

* H.S. Diploma/GED Required
* Completion of an accredited Medical Assistant program (or higher-level equivalent) Required
* + OR 18 months of experience working as an MA may be considered in lieu of MA program completion.
  + OR 1+ year working as a Clinical Support Representative at Penn Medicine may be considered in lieu of MA program completion.
* 2+ years’ Medical Office or Customer Service experience.
* Associate’s degree preferred.

We believe that the best care for our patients starts with the best care for our employees. Our employee benefits programs help our employees get healthy and stay healthy. We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits program that includes one of the finest prepaid tuition assistance programs in the region. Penn Medicine employees are actively engaged and committed to our mission. Together we will continue to make medical advances that help people live longer, healthier lives.  
  
Live Your Life's Work

We are an Equal Opportunity employer. Candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, familial status, genetic information, domestic or sexual violence victim status, citizenship status, military status, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable law.

Job Posting Title

**ASSISTANT PROGRAM COORDINATOR**

**Job Description**

**BUILD A CAREER WITH PURPOSE**

**ASSISTANT PROGRAM COORDINATOR**
=================================

**Assistant Program Coordinator**  
**Full-Time**  
**DailyPay Available**

**Looking for More Than Just a Job?**
-------------------------------------

At **Supportive Concepts for Families, Inc.**, we believe every person deserves the opportunity to live a meaningful, fulfilling, and independent life.

We're seeking compassionate, dedicated professionals who are looking for more than a paycheck. We're looking for individuals who want to make a difference, build rewarding careers, and become part of a team committed to helping others succeed.

Whether you're beginning your leadership journey or bringing experience in residential services, we provide the training, support, and opportunities needed to help you thrive.

**Paid training provided.**

**About Supportive Concepts for Families, Inc.**
------------------------------------------------

For more than 30 years, **Supportive Concepts for Families, Inc.** has been dedicated to improving lives through high-quality services and support.

Our employees play a vital role in helping individuals achieve greater independence, confidence, and success while promoting dignity, respect, inclusion, and personal choice.

Every day, our team members make a meaningful impact by supporting people in reaching their goals and living their best lives.

**Why Join Our Team?**
----------------------

### **Competitive Pay & Benefits**

* Competitive Compensation
* DailyPay – Access Your Earned Wages Before Payday
* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Employee Assistance Program
* Wellness Programs
* Employee Referral Bonuses

### **Career Growth & Development**

* Paid Training Programs
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Certification Opportunities
* Leadership Development Programs
* Career Advancement Opportunities

### **Meaningful Work That Matters**

* Make a Difference Every Day
* Support Individuals and Families
* Build Meaningful Relationships
* Strengthen Communities
* Join a Mission-Driven Organization

**Who We're Looking For**

You may be a great fit if you are:

✔ Compassionate  
✔ Dependable  
✔ Patient  
✔ Team-Oriented  
✔ Service-Focused  
✔ Professional  
✔ Positive  
✔ Committed to Helping Others

* High School Diploma or GED
* One (1) year of experience in human services or a related field
* Valid driver's license, current vehicle registration, reliable transportation, and current vehicle insurance
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office programs
* Ability to work independently while maintaining professionalism and sound judgment
* Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills
* Ability to supervise and support direct care staff
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and comply with HIPAA requirements

### **Preferred:**

* Knowledge of and ability to work with individuals with mental health diagnoses
* Experience in residential services, behavioral health, or developmental disability programs
* Strong documentation and organizational skills
* Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities

**Schedule**
------------

* Full-Time
* Flexible schedule based on program needs
* Some evenings, weekends, and holidays may be required
* Participation in an on-call rotation is required

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------

* Ability to lift, push, and/or pull up to 50 pounds
* Ability to sit, stand, walk, bend, reach, stoop, twist, and climb stairs
* Ability to drive a vehicle and operate adaptive equipment and household appliances
* Ability to perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation

**Apply Today**
---------------

Some jobs pay the bills. Some jobs build careers. This job changes lives.

If you're looking for meaningful work where your compassion, leadership, and dedication make a real difference every day, we encourage you to apply today.

**Join our team and become the reason someone has a better day.**

df86051799f06dbdc41d.title: Dental Patient Care Coordinator
df86051799f06dbdc41d.description:
Join Affordable Dentures & Implants at our Wyomissing practice and Help Create Healthy, Confident Smiles!
  
Are you an experienced Dental Front Office Coordinator, Dental Receptionist, Treatment Coordinator, or Patient Care Coordinator looking for a rewarding career? Affordable Dentures & Implants is seeking a compassionate, organized professional to become the first point of contact for our patients. In this role, you'll help deliver an exceptional patient experience while supporting our dentists, dental assistants, and laboratory team in providing life-changing tooth replacement solutions.
  
If you enjoy building relationships with patients, coordinating dental care, and working in a fast-paced dental practice, we'd love to hear from you!
  
Why Join Affordable Dentures & Implants?
  

* Be part of a team dedicated to transforming lives through quality tooth replacement care.
* Work alongside experienced dentists, dental assistants, and on-site laboratory professionals.
* Enjoy opportunities for career growth and professional development.
* Make a meaningful impact by helping patients restore their smiles and confidence every day.

What You'll Do
  

* Welcome patients and provide a warm, professional first impression.
* Manage patient check-in, check-out, appointment scheduling, confirmations, and recalls.
* Verify dental insurance benefits, eligibility, and pre-authorizations when applicable.
* Prepare and review dental treatment plans with patients.
* Explain treatment recommendations, estimated patient financial responsibility, and financing options.
* Collect co-pays, payments, and outstanding balances while maintaining accurate financial records.
* Maintain accounts receivable (A/R) and assist with patient billing and collections.
* Answer multi-line phones and respond to patient questions regarding appointments, treatment, insurance, and payments.
* Maintain accurate electronic dental records (EHR/EMR), patient charts, consent forms, and HIPAA-compliant documentation.
* Coordinate communication between patients, dentists, dental assistants, and laboratory staff.
* Support daily office operations to ensure an efficient patient flow.

Qualifications
  

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Previous experience in a dental office, oral surgery, prosthodontic, periodontic, orthodontic, or other healthcare practice preferred. Experience in treatment coordination, patient scheduling, or patient services.
* Knowledge of dental insurance verification, benefit breakdowns, claims, and predeterminations.
* Experience discussing treatment estimates, patient financing, and payment arrangements.
* Familiarity with dental practice management software (Dentrix (preferred), Eaglesoft, Open Dental, Curve Dental, or similar).
* Experience maintaining patient records and scheduling within a dental practice.
* Strong customer service, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to multitask in a fast-paced dental office while maintaining accuracy and professionalism.
* Bilingual candidates are encouraged to apply.

**We're Looking For Someone Who Is:**  

* Friendly, professional, and compassionate
* Detail-oriented and highly organized
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities
* Passionate about delivering exceptional patient experiences
* Dependable, motivated, and eager to grow within a successful dental practice

If you're passionate about patient care, dental office operations, and delivering exceptional service, we encourage you to apply today!
  
**Keywords:** Dental Front Office, Dental Receptionist, Front Desk Coordinator, Patient Care Coordinator, Dental Office Administrator, Dental Scheduling, Dentrix, Dental Insurance, Patient Services, CareCredit, Dental Office, Treatment Coordinator, Dental Administrative Assistant.
  
  
Benefits
  
We care about our employees and understand the hard work that goes into providing the best-in-class patient care. You will be provided the training needed to provide you with the support you need to do your job well. Additional benefits include, group medical and dental insurance, vision insurance, life insurance, flexible spending (health and dependent care), 401(k), 9 paid holidays off, 10 days of vacation, and 5 additional PTO days. We also offer ancillary benefits to include hospital indemnity, accident, and critical illness insurance options.
  
  
About Affordable Care
  
Founded in 1975, today Affordable Care, LLC is America’s largest dental support organization (DSO) focused on tooth replacement services, serving more than 360 dental practices across the United States. Supported practices primarily concentrate on extractions, dentures, implants, and fixed arches, with some practices housing an on-site laboratory to enable same-day dental services. Affordable Care is the DSO for several top dental brands including, but not limited to, Affordable Dentures & Implants, DDS Dentures + Implant Solutions, and Advanced Dental Implant Centers. From the Affordable Care Support Center, located in North Carolina’s Research Triangle Park, along with field-based teams, Affordable Care provides business expertise and support services to dental practices, taking care of non-clinical duties so dentists can focus on treating patients (visit affordablecare.com).
  
#ADIAux

d8b55dc8f2f99c9c5b1a.description:
Posting Title: Behavioral Health Patient Engagement Scheduler (Remote) (Full-Time) Overview:

The Behavioral Health Patient Engagement Scheduler (“Patient Engagement Scheduler”) reports to Behavioral Health Patient Support Services Coordinator and in lieu the VP of Operations-Behavioral Health and is a member of the Behavioral Health team. The Behavioral Health Patient Engagement Scheduler is responsible for proactively engaging existing Fast Pace Health patients who have been identified through elevated behavioral health screening scores, including the PHQ-9 and GAD-7, indicating potential symptoms of depression and/or anxiety. This position serves as a connection between Fast Pace Health's urgent care and Behavioral Health services by conducting patient outreach, providing education regarding available behavioral health treatment options, and facilitating the scheduling of initial intake appointments for interested patients.

The Patient Engagement Scheduler plays an important role in improving patient access to behavioral health care, increasing awareness and utilization of available services, and supporting early intervention for patients experiencing mental health concerns. Responsibilities include verifying and confirming patient insurance eligibility, ensuring accurate patient information, and utilizing electronic health records (EHR), scheduling platforms, communication systems, and other technology necessary to efficiently perform daily duties. This role requires effective communication, compassion, attention to detail, technological proficiency, and the ability to maintain consistent outreach productivity while ensuring a positive patient experience. The position works collaboratively with the Behavioral Health Patient Support Services team and other departments to promote continuity of care, improve patient engagement, and support overall program growth.

Why Choose Fast Pace Health?:

Fast Pace Health is a growing company! You will have the support and mentoring you need to become the best Behavioral Health Call Specialist you can be! We will help you grow your clinical competencies, and can offer you a rewarding career path. We work as a dynamic team to surpass our business goals by ensuring our patients receive the best care possible in a positive environment.
  
  
We offer competitive compensation and benefits such as holiday pay, PTO, medical, dental, vision and Work-Life balance, to name a few.
  
  
As a Fast Pace Health employee you will have the opportunity to participate in community events and outreach programs. This includes, but is not limited to, seasonal parades, book drives, festivals, trunk or treating, fun runs, and more. We dress up for holidays and celebrate with pot lucks. At Fast Pace, our community is our family, and we are a family first community.

Responsibilities:

**Essential Functions:**

* Promote the five principles of Fast Pace: Communication, Teamwork, Empowerment, Quality of Care, and Friendliness.
* Proactively contact existing Fast Pace Health patients identified through elevated behavioral health screening scores, including PHQ-9 and GAD-7 assessments, to offer education and access to Behavioral Health services.
* Educate patients on available Behavioral Health services, including psychiatric medication management, counseling/therapy, telehealth options, and the process for establishing care.
* Engage patients through compassionate, professional, and effective communication while encouraging appropriate utilization of Behavioral Health services.
* Schedule initial Behavioral Health intake appointments for interested patients, ensuring appropriate provider selection, appointment availability, and scheduling guidelines are followed.
* Verify and confirm patient insurance coverage, eligibility, and applicable requirements prior to scheduling appointments, addressing or escalating identified barriers as appropriate.
* Maintain established daily outreach productivity expectations, including a minimum average of 80 patient outreach calls per workday, while meeting departmental quality and performance standards.
* Accurately document all patient outreach attempts, patient responses, education provided, scheduling outcomes, and reasons for declining services within designated systems.
* Utilize electronic health records (EHR), scheduling platforms, insurance verification systems, Microsoft Office applications, communication tools, and other required technology efficiently and accurately.
* Maintain and manage assigned patient outreach lists, ensuring timely follow-up, appropriate tracking, and completion of assigned outreach activities.
* Identify and appropriately escalate patient concerns, questions regarding clinical care, or reported symptoms requiring further assessment to designated clinical personnel in accordance with established protocols.
* Demonstrate knowledge of Behavioral Health scheduling policies, accepted insurance plans, patient eligibility requirements, and established departmental workflows.
* Collaborate with Behavioral Health team members, urgent care teams, and other departments to facilitate patient access, continuity of care, and resolution of scheduling barriers.
* Maintain strict patient confidentiality and compliance with HIPAA regulations, organizational policies, and established standards for patient communication and documentation.
* Monitor individual performance metrics, including outreach volume, patient engagement, appointment conversion rates, and scheduling accuracy, while identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Participate in required training, departmental meetings, process improvement initiatives, and other duties as assigned to support patient satisfaction, operational efficiency, and overall Behavioral Health program growth.
* The ability to maintain a positive work atmosphere by acting and communicating in a manner that results in a positive work relationship with patients, co-workers, and managers.
* The ability to perform the physical, use of senses, cognitive, and environmental functions of the position, as specified on the physical demands.
* Ability to comply with Company standards of operations.
* The ability to promote and maintain a respectful culture of employee, employer and business confidentiality.

**Non-Essential Functions:**

* Perform other duties as assigned by management.

Experience Requirements and Preferences::

**Experience:**

* Healthcare experience in Medical or Behavioral Health
* At least 2 years of experience in call center, front desk, or as clinic coordinator in an outpatient setting
* Experience in behavioral health setting preferred
* Electronic appointment scheduling experience preferred
* Strong customer service experience
* Excellent Verbal communication skills
* Proven ability to Multi-Task
* Problem Solving and critical thinking skills a plus

Education Requirements:: High School Diploma or Its Equivalent Compliance:

Fast Pace Health is committed to the principle of equal employment and creating an inclusive environment for the benefit of our employees, our patients and our communities. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome job applications from qualified individuals without regard to race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, parental status, genetic information or any other legally protected characteristics or conduct.

https://www.dol.gov/whd/regs/compliance/posters/eppac.pdf

282471a3160e7985dc61.title: Referral Coordinator (Bilingual)
282471a3160e7985dc61.description:
**Join the Trusted Results Therapy Group Team**

At Trusted Results Therapy Group (TRTG), we believe great care starts with great people. We are a growing, clinician-led behavioral health organization committed to making high-quality mental health services accessible to individuals and families across South Carolina.

What makes TRTG different is our people and our purpose. We have built a collaborative, supportive environment where team members are encouraged to grow professionally, bring new ideas forward, and make a meaningful impact in the communities we serve.

As a CARF-accredited organization, we are committed to high standards of care while continuing to expand the services and resources available to our clients. Our team includes professionals across therapy, psychiatry, psychological testing, rehabilitative behavioral health services, school-based services, nursing, administration, operations, and leadership — all working together toward one mission: helping people achieve trusted results.

  

**Why Join TRTG?**

When you join TRTG, you become part of an organization that values:

* Meaningful work that directly impacts individuals, families, and communities
* A collaborative, team-centered culture
* Professional growth, training, and leadership development
* Opportunities to grow as the organization continues to expand
* Innovation and new ideas from every level of the organization
* A commitment to accessibility and reducing barriers to mental healthcare
* High standards for quality, ethics, and client care
* A workplace built around our core values of Trust, Results, Accessibility, and Community

  

We are looking for people who want more than just a job. We want team members who care about the work, care about the people around them, and want to be part of an organization making a lasting difference in mental healthcare across South Carolina.

If that sounds like you, we would love to learn more about you.

**Position Summary:**
  
The Referral Coordinator manages the referral intake process from receipt through scheduling, ensuring patients are triaged, matched with the appropriate provider, and scheduled promptly. This role serves as a key point of contact for incoming referrals and patient outreach, working closely with the intake team to deliver a smooth experience from first contact through appointment scheduling.  
  
***Referral Intake & Triage***
  

* Receive and enter referrals from MedSender into Atlas
* Upload referral and insurance eligibility verification into Atlas
* Triage and tag service type — therapy, medication management, psychological testing, or a combination
* Manage specialty payer / contracts

  
***Patient Outreach & Scheduling***
  

* Contact patients same-day to confirm service interest and verify insurance
* Match patients to the appropriate provider based on insurance, location, and availability
* Schedule appointments for mental health therapy and medication management services
* Send intake forms the same day an appointment is scheduled

  
***Follow-Up & Discharge***
  

* Notify referring provider upon receipt of referral
* Manage a 3-attempt follow-up queue over 8 days for patients who have not been reached
* Discharge patients after 3 failed contact attempts and notify the referring practitioner
* All other duties as assigned

  
***Required Qualifications***
  

* Associate's or bachelor's degree in health sciences, psychology, or a related field
* 1+ year of experience in a medical or behavioral health administrative role
* Clinical literacy — familiarity with mental health service types and terminology
* Strong phone communication and patient-facing skills
* HIPAA knowledge and compliance awareness
* Experience with EHR Preferred Qualifications
* Experience as a Behavioral Health Technician (BHT) or medical scheduler
* Familiarity with insurance platforms, Dialpad
* Experience in a multi-department or multi-location practice
* Bilingual

  
**This is a remote role, you must be a SC, TX, IL, or CO state resident to apply.**

  

**EEO Statement**

  

Trusted Results Therapy Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of color, religion, national origin, age, genetics, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or other legally protected status in employment opportunities and benefits.

  

**Other Duties**

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

  

**Signatures**

This job description has been approved by management.

014d2b956098f196eb47.title: Senior Administrative Coordinator
014d2b956098f196eb47.description:
The Senior Administrative Coordinator provides high-level administrative, financial, and operational support for a designated region. This remote role is responsible for managing regional organization and reporting. The position serves as a key liaison between operational deliverables and regional leadership. Accountability, consistency, and the timely execution of business priorities are critical to success in this role. This role requires strong organizational skills, financial acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

**Compensation: $27.00/hr. (US Dollars)**  
The pay listed is the salary range for this position. Any specific offer will vary based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, and alignment with market data. You may be eligible to participate in a Company incentive or bonus program.

**Executive & Administrative Support**

* Provides direct administrative support to the Director of Operations.
* Manages calendars, meeting coordination, project tracking, action item follow-up, and operational communications.
* Prepare presentations, reports, dashboards, meeting materials, and executive summaries.
* Coordinates regional meetings, business reviews, operational calls, and leadership communications.
* Maintains organized electronic records, documentation, and business files in accordance with company standards.
* Serves as a central point of coordination between field operations, corporate functions, and leadership teams.

**Data Management, Reporting & Spreadsheet Administration**

  

* Develops, maintains, and manages complex spreadsheets, databases, trackers, and reporting tools supporting operational performance.
* Consolidates information from multiple sources to generate accurate regional reports and dashboards.
* Maintains reporting schedules and ensures timely delivery of operational, compliance, staffing, and financial reports.
* Performs quality assurance reviews of reports to ensure data integrity and accuracy.
* Creates standardized reporting templates and tools to improve consistency and efficiency throughout the region.

**Compliance, Governance & Operational Support**

  

* Maintains compliance trackers and monitors completion of required operational, safety, training, and contractual obligations.
* Supports internal audits, governance reviews, customer reporting requirements, and account compliance initiatives.
* Partners with operational leadership to ensure adherence to company policies, contractual standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Monitors outstanding compliance actions and drives timely completion through follow-up and reporting.

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

  

* Produces clear and professional correspondence, presentations, and executive communications.
* Maintains strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate efficient business operations.
* Handles sensitive and confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
* Ensures timely communication of deadlines, reporting requirements, and operational priorities.

**Process & Continuous Improvement**

  

* Identifies opportunities to enhance administrative, reporting, financial, and compliance processes.
* Develop standardized templates, procedures, and tools that improve efficiency and consistency across the region.
* Supports automation and process-improvement initiatives involving reporting, financial administration, and operational workflows.
* Assists leadership with special projects and strategic initiatives as assigned.

**Other duties as assigned**

Job duties may be modified at any time to support operational requirements, organizational priorities, compliance obligations, or business initiatives.

* High School Diploma or GED required; associate or bachelor’s degree in business administration, Finance, Accounting, Operations Management, or related field preferred.
* Minimum 3-5 years of administrative, operational, financial, or executive support experience.
* Experience supporting senior leadership, regional management teams, or multi-site operations preferred.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, reporting, and data analysis.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
* Experience managing budgets, expense reports, financial tracking, and P&L support activities.
* Ability to create, maintain, and analyze complex spreadsheets and reporting tools.
* Strong understanding of compliance reporting, governance processes, and administrative controls.
* Exceptional organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive business information with discretion.
