81cb46d53a753fdcc345.title: President's Office Coordinator
81cb46d53a753fdcc345.company: Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts
81cb46d53a753fdcc345.description:
**Location:** Philadelphia, PA

**Position:** Full-time

**Reports to:** Director of Executive Affairs and Strategic Projects

**Position Summary**

The Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts (PAFA) seeks a highly organized, detail-oriented, and professional Assistant to the President's Office to provide administrative and coordination support to the President and the Director of Executive Affairs and Strategic Projects.

This position plays an important role in ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of the President's Office, supporting executive scheduling, Board of Trustees activities, institutional meetings and events, and administrative aspects of strategic initiatives.

The ideal candidate is an exceptional organizer and multitasker who takes pride in managing details, anticipating needs, and helping others stay prepared. They will bring a polished, courteous demeanor, sound judgment, excellent communication skills, and the discretion necessary to work effectively with senior leadership, trustees, staff, and external stakeholders.

This is a hands-on administrative coordination role for someone who thrives in a busy, collaborative environment and enjoys making things run smoothly.

**Key Responsibilities**

**President's Office Support**

* Provide day-to-day administrative support to the President, including complex calendar management, meeting scheduling, and coordination of appointments.
* Prepare and process expense reports, reimbursements, and other administrative documentation.
* Assist with the preparation, formatting, and management of correspondence, invitations, acknowledgments, and other communications from the President's Office.
* Coordinate meeting arrangements, including room reservations, materials, refreshments, and other logistics as needed.
* Organize domestic travel arrangements and subsequent documentation and reimbursement needs on behalf of the President.
* Anticipate scheduling and administrative needs, ensuring the President is well prepared for upcoming meetings and commitments.
* Maintain organized records and files, handling sensitive information with confidentiality and discretion.

**Board of Trustees Coordination**

* Support the Director of Executive Affairs and Strategic Projects in coordinating meetings of the Board of Trustees and its standing Committees.
* Manage scheduling, calendar invitations, meeting confirmations, and related communications with a national Board of Trustees.
* Coordinate logistics for quarterly Board meetings (*four per calendar year*), including meeting spaces, catering, technology needs, advance reading materials, and other arrangements as required.
* Manage the administrative production and distribution of quarterly Board books, coordinating the collection, organization, formatting, and timely delivery of meeting materials.
* Attend Board and Committee meetings and prepare accurate and prompt meeting minutes when requested.
* Maintain organized records of Board and Committee meeting materials, minutes, and related documentation.
* Communicate professionally and courteously with Trustees, ensuring a high level of responsiveness and overall attention to detail.

**Internal Staff Meetings and Institutional Events**

* Coordinate logistics for All-Staff meetings, including scheduling, room setup, audiovisual needs, refreshments, and meeting materials.
* Organize Staff gatherings, outings, celebrations, and other employee engagement and recognition activities, managing invitations, RSVPs, vendors, and event logistics.
* Work collaboratively with colleagues across departments to ensure meetings and events are well organized and smoothly executed.
* Support other special meetings and institutional activities coordinated through the President's Office.

**Strategic Projects and Administrative Coordination**

* Provide scheduling and administrative support to the Director of Executive Affairs and Strategic Projects.
* Assist with meeting coordination, document organization, materials preparation, and administrative follow-up related to PAFA's ongoing strategic planning process and other institutional initiatives.
* Help maintain project calendars, meeting schedules, and organized records to support timely execution of work.
* Track administrative deadlines and anticipate upcoming logistical needs.
* Undertake additional administrative and coordination assignments in support of the President's Office.

**-**

**Qualifications**

***Required***

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university.
* Excellent organizational skills, meticulous attention to detail, and demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to draft clear, professional correspondence and accurately capture meeting discussions.
* A polished, courteous, and professional demeanor, with the confidence to interact comfortably with senior executives, Trustees, donors, and other institutional stakeholders.
* Sound judgment, discretion, and an unwavering commitment to maintaining confidentiality and handling sensitive discourse.
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, as well as familiarity with virtual meeting platforms.
* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and anticipate needs of the President and members of Senior Staff rather than waiting for direction.
* Strong time-management skills and the ability to remain calm, flexible, and effective when managing competing deadlines.
* A collaborative, service-oriented attitude and willingness to assist wherever needed.

***Preferred***

* One to three years of administrative, office coordination, or related professional experience.
* Experience supporting senior leadership, a Board of Trustees/Directors, or a busy professional office staffing a senior principal.
* Experience coordinating meetings, preparing meeting materials, and organizing events.
* Interest in the fine arts, museums, or nonprofit organizations.
* Familiarity with Blackbaud platforms / willingness to learn new platforms to track Presidential actions.

**Personal Attributes**

The successful candidate will be:

* **Exceptionally organized:** Someone who enjoys creating order, keeping track of complex details, and ensuring that nothing falls through the cracks.
* **Proactive and resourceful:** A person who thinks several steps ahead and takes initiative to address needs before they become problems.
* **Polished, diplomatic, and positive:** Comfortable representing the President's Office with professionalism, warmth, and good judgment. Positively and enthusiastically willing to take on additional related tasks as assigned.
* **Calm under pressure:** Able to balance multiple requests and changing priorities without becoming flustered.
* **Discreet and trustworthy:** Someone who understands the importance of confidentiality and handles sensitive matters with maturity and professionalism.
* **Collaborative and dependable:** A team player who takes satisfaction in supporting colleagues and contributing to the success of the institution in a light-hearted and camaraderie-driven workplace.

**About PAFA**

*Founded in 1805, the Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts is the nation's first school and museum of fine arts. Located in Philadelphia, PAFA is dedicated to collecting, exhibiting, and interpreting American art and to educating artists and audiences. Through its museum, exhibitions, public programs, and fine arts education programs, PAFA fosters artistic excellence, creativity, and engagement with the visual arts.*

99b29c17bd6ee4b5c8d5.title: Front Office Coordinator Float
99b29c17bd6ee4b5c8d5.description:
Position Overview:

**Greater Purpose and Core Values:** Athletico’s Greater Purpose is to empower people, inspire hope and transform lives. We accomplish this by providing exceptional, progressive, and cost-effective fitness, performance and rehabilitative services through personalized care that emphasizes education and prevention of future injury. This is accomplished through building on our Core Values of one team, understanding our business, recognition, people-focused, accountability, continuous innovation and trust and integrity, which are the foundation for our unique culture.

**Position Summary:**

The Patient Experience Coordinator (PEC) Float supports a group of clinics as a flexible front-office resource, delivering high-quality patient service and operational coverage wherever the need is greatest. The Float receives day-to-day coverage priorities through the regional Patient Experience team and partners closely with Clinic Managers, clinic teams, and Patient Experience leaders. The role protects clinic continuity during PTO, vacancies, call-offs, high-volume periods, onboarding, and transitions while reinforcing consistent standards and a seamless patient experience across every clinic served.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Provide professional, friendly, and compassionate service to patients, caregivers, and clinic teams in every interaction, including issue resolution and service recovery.
* Manage clinic schedules while covering assigned locations, matching patients with the appropriate clinician and maintaining access and patient flow.
* Complete new patient onboarding, including orientation, demographic and insurance data gathering, payment expectations, and warm handoffs to clinic staff.
* Verify patient insurance, support authorization and pre-certification requirements, and communicate benefits and payment options, escalating barriers through established workflows.
* Collect time-of-service payments and support patient balance conversations consistent with company standards.
* Coordinate patient-progress communication with physicians, nurse case managers, adjusters, and attorneys as directed by clinic priorities.
* Support patient expectations for visit frequency, scheduling, discharge planning, and post-care questions, partnering with the treating clinician for clinical guidance.
* Execute and reinforce Patient Experience SOPs across all assigned clinics, adapting to local workflows only when approved and not in conflict with standard work.
* Provide front-desk coverage for PEC PTO, vacancies, call-offs, leaves of absence, clinic openings, transitions, and high-volume periods.
* Support new or struggling PECs through shadowing, side-by-side coaching, and SOP reinforcement, with feedback on progress and barriers to the regional Patient Experience team.
* Complete process audits, observations, and adherence checks as assigned to identify workflow variation and improvement opportunities.
* Maintain clear coverage handoffs by reviewing clinic notes before arrival, documenting work completed, and communicating open items to the PEC and clinic leadership.
* Travel between clinics as assigned, managing time, mileage, equipment, and clinic access responsibly and flagging barriers that affect coverage.
* Support remote or hybrid operational work when assigned, including patient outreach, report cleanup, authorization follow-up, and multi-clinic task support.
* Adopt new systems and workflows, including the Raintree EMR, and support consistent use across covered clinics.
* Support clinic culture and patient recognition moments in partnership with the clinical team.
* Receive clinic assignments, coverage priorities, SOP guidance, and escalation direction through the regional Patient Experience team.
* Partner with Clinic Managers and clinic teams while covering in clinic, aligning on daily priorities, schedule needs, and clinic-specific handoffs.
* Act independently on routine front-office tasks within established SOPs; escalates policy exceptions, patient complaints, unresolved insurance or authorization barriers, and resource needs.
* Serve as a cross-clinic resource and process observer, sharing best practices and recurring barriers to improve consistency across the region.

**Qualifications:**

* Education:
  + High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor's degree preferred.
* Work Experience:
  + 1+ years of customer service, healthcare front-office, or administrative experience preferred; prior PEC or medical front-desk experience strongly preferred.
  + Experience supporting multiple locations or working in coverage/float capacities a plus.
* Knowledge and Technical Skills:
  + Strong customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills; able to build rapport quickly with new teams and adapt to different clinic environments.
  + Working knowledge of insurance verification, authorizations, and time-of-service collections, or demonstrated ability to learn quickly.
  + Proficiency with scheduling and EMR systems and Microsoft Office; able to learn new systems, including Raintree.
  + Strong organization, time management, and reliability; able to work independently with minimal day-to-day supervision.

**Language Skills:**

* Ability to read, write and speak English proficiently

**Physical Demands:**

* Ability to fulfill office activities including but not limited to remain stationary for extended periods of time (i.e., while working at a desk), stoop/kneel/crouch, travel around the office, communicate with others (verbal and written), and use fine motor skills including fine hand manipulation and keyboarding.
* Ability to see at close range, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.
* Regular travel between assigned clinics is an essential function of this role. A valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and proof of insurance are required. Mileage is reimbursed in accordance with company policy.

**Work Environment:**

* Consistent with a standard office environment, noise level is low with little to no extraordinary environmental factors.

*Athletico provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

Minimum Salary/Wage: USD$ 15.00 Hr. Maximum Salary/Wage: USD$ 23.50 Hr.

* Experience preparing, proofreading, and formatting legal documents and correspondence.
* Excellent proofreading, written communication, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail, professionalism, and ability to maintain client confidentiality.

**Preferred**

* Experience with legal billing and practice management software.
* Familiarity with family law terminology, procedures, and documentation.
* Previous experience supporting attorneys in a small or growing law firm.

**Position Details**

* **Location:** Remote – Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, or North Carolina residents only
* **Schedule:** Part-time, 20 hours per week
* **Compensation:** $23 per hour
* **Benefits:** Paid Time Off (PTO)

**Please Note:** This position is open to individual applicants only. No staffing agencies, third-party recruiters, or solicitation inquiries, please.

b6f368f94d9ded350d31.description:
Welcome2YourNewHome is seeking a personable, resourceful, highly organized individual to assist with the management of residential single-family rental properties in and around the Charlotte area.

This is a primarily work-from-home opportunity focused on making phone calls, developing relationships with vendors, obtaining quotes, coordinating appointments, communicating with prospective tenants, and maintaining accurate records in Google Sheets and other databases.

We have a **strong preference for someone who can assist with both work-from-home responsibilities and occasional visits to our rental homes throughout Charlotte and surrounding communities.** Being involved in both provides valuable firsthand knowledge of our properties, vendors, and operations, allowing for more effective communication, coordination, and follow-through.

We welcome applicants with experience in sales, administrative assistance, management, property management, real estate, customer relations, or other positions requiring strong interpersonal and organizational skills.

We're especially interested in someone who naturally builds rapport, understands how to communicate with different personalities, knows what to say and when to say it, and enjoys developing positive professional relationships.

**We prefer someone interested in a long-term, part-time, as-needed working relationship.** Hours are not guaranteed, and work will vary based on business needs.

Primary Work-From-Home Responsibilities

The majority of work will involve:

* **Vendor Calls and Relationships:** Research, identify, call, evaluate, and develop relationships with handypeople, electricians, plumbers, painters, landscapers, and other service providers.
* **Quotes and Scheduling:** Obtain and compare estimates for repairs, maintenance, materials, and services. Coordinate appointments and follow up on progress.
* **Google Sheets and Database Management:** Enter and update vendor contact information, call notes, quotes, appointment details, follow-up tasks, and other property-related information.
* **Prospective Tenant Calls:** Contact rental inquiries to answer routine questions, coordinate showing appointments, confirm interest, and obtain feedback following property visits.
* **Communication and Follow-Through:** Maintain regular communication with vendors and other contacts to ensure work moves forward efficiently and information remains accurate and organized.

These calling, coordination, follow-up, and recordkeeping activities will make up the **core of the position**.

Additional Work-From-Home Opportunities

Depending on experience, interests, and business needs, other work may include:

* Tenant communication and administrative assistance.
* Property and vendor research.
* Preparing documents, reports, and spreadsheets.
* General administrative and bookkeeping support.
* Rental advertising, marketing, website updates, and social media.
* Researching products, materials, pricing, and property improvements.
* Helping improve company procedures, systems, and operations.
* Other organizational or consulting projects.

Optional Boots-on-the-Ground Work: Visits to Rental Properties

For individuals available to travel locally to our rental homes throughout Charlotte and surrounding communities, additional work may include:

* Meeting vendors and contractors at rental properties.
* Photographing and documenting property conditions, repairs, or completed work.
* Assisting with move-in and move-out documentation.
* Visiting properties to verify maintenance progress.
* Placing or removing lockboxes.
* **Setting up and troubleshooting Ring cameras, keyless entry locks, internet, and other smart-home devices.**
* Coordinating keys and property access.
* Picking up supplies or materials from local retailers.
* Helping prepare rental homes for new tenants.
* Staging Kitchens and Bathrooms with small items
* Sometimes staging small pieces of furniture like chairs, side tables, desks, entry tables
* Assisting with prospective tenant visits or showings when legally authorized.
* Performing occasional property-related errands.
* Being our company representative in court with the attorney for summary ejectment (optional)

While visiting properties is not required for every contractor, **we strongly prefer applicants who are available for both work-from-home responsibilities and visits to our rental homes**, as this provides better continuity, familiarity with our properties, and more effective overall assistance.

Qualifications and Qualities We Value

**Required:**

* Previous experience working with or coordinating vendors, service providers, clients, or similar professional contacts.
* Excellent telephone communication and relationship-building skills.
* Strong organizational abilities and attention to detail.
* Comfort using Google Sheets or similar spreadsheet and database tools.
* Ability to work independently, manage work, and follow through without constant supervision.
* Resourcefulness, good judgment, and strong problem-solving skills.

**Preferred:**

* Background in sales, administration, management, customer service, property management, or real estate.
* Experience obtaining quotes, scheduling services, or coordinating projects.
* Availability to visit rental properties throughout the Charlotte area.
* **Comfort with Ring cameras, keyless entry locks, and other smart-home technology (or willing to learn - it's pretty easy and almost plug and play.).**
* Interest in a long-term, part-time, as-needed working relationship.
* Active North Carolina real estate license (a plus, but not required).

**Personal Qualities:**

We value someone who is friendly, confident, personable, professional, quick-thinking, patient, empathetic, adaptable, and dependable.

The ideal person knows how to create genuine rapport, communicate effectively with different personalities, ask the right questions, and recognize when and how to follow up.

We're looking for someone who takes initiative, enjoys solving problems, learns quickly, and takes pride in getting things accomplished.

Compensation and Work Arrangement

* $18 per hour for work-from-home administrative and coordination work.
* $20 per hour for approved work performed at rental properties.
* Certain projects may be compensated at an agreed flat fee.
* Work is offered as needed, with no minimum or guaranteed hours. (There could be a week or weeks where there is nothing needed.).
* Contractors may accept or decline individual projects, always.
* The scope, compensation, and deadlines for each project will be discussed in advance.
* Contractors may provide services to other clients or businesses.

This opportunity is intended for someone seeking a flexible, ongoing professional relationship rather than a traditional full-time or part-time position.

Certain real estate, leasing, and court-related activities require appropriate licensing or legal authorization. Work will be limited to activities the contractor is legally permitted to perform.

Pay: From $18.00 per hour

Expected hours: 1.0 – 10.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* Are you available for remote work and boots on the ground at houses or just remote work?
* Do you have your NC real estate license?
* What days and times are you generally available to work from home and at rental houses?

Location:

* Charlotte, NC (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

Our Investment in You:

* Full-time remote work

* Competitive salaries

* Excellent benefits

* Communicate determinations to members and providers via incoming and outgoing telephone calls, fax notifications, and letter notifications

* Responsible for analysis and issue resolution as it pertains to the administration of the formulary and benefits

* Excellent Customer Service skills

* Prior experience assisting members and/or providers with telephone inquiries

* Strong organizational, problem solving, communication, and interpersonal skills

0aab554eb9830d1d9f67.title: ABA Scheduling Coordinator
0aab554eb9830d1d9f67.description:
**ABA Scheduling Coordinator – Client & Staff Scheduling Across Two Clinics**

**Full-Time | Remote (US) | $55,000 – $60,000 per year**

**About Odyssey Autism**

At Odyssey Autism, we're on a mission to guide little heroes on their BIG adventures. We provide individualized, evidence-based Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy for children ages 2–12, helping families access the support they need to thrive.

We're a growing, BCBA-led organization with clinics in Phoenix and Tucson, built around clinical excellence, strong relationships, and a genuine commitment to the families we serve. As we grow, we're adding a dedicated scheduling role, so every child gets consistent care and every authorized therapy hour is covered.

**Job Summary**

We're hiring an experienced ABA Scheduling Coordinator to own client and staff scheduling across two of our Phoenix clinics. You'll build and maintain weekly schedules, keep every authorized therapy hour covered, and solve same-day callouts so children keep getting the care they need.

You'll be the single point of contact for scheduling at both sites, partnering with BCBAs, RBTs, families, intake, and billing. You'll report to our Operations Manager, with hands-on training, clear expectations, and ongoing support.

**This isn't just a calendar-keeping position.** Your judgment, speed, and follow-through directly affect whether children receive their recommended hours and whether our clinicians' days run smoothly.

**Responsibilities**

**Schedule Across Both Clinics**

* Build and maintain recurring weekly schedules for all clients, RBTs, and BCBAs, matching staff to clients by availability, location, skill set, and continuity of care.
* Balance staffing between the two sites, moving coverage where it is needed most and keeping clinician utilization high.
* Schedule assessments, reassessments, parent training, and BCBA supervision alongside direct therapy.
* Match newly hired RBTs and newly enrolled clients to open hours and build their starting schedules.

  

**Own Callouts & Coverage**

* Own the same-day callout process: find substitutes, rebook sessions, and notify families and staff quickly.
* On callout-coverage days, start early (around 6:30 a.m. Arizona time) so coverage is set before the first sessions begin.
* Track client and staff cancellations, spot patterns, and flag recurring issues to clinical leadership.
* Reschedule proactively so each client receives as many recommended hours as possible.

  

**Keep Authorizations & Data Accurate**

* Track client authorizations and schedule against approved hours and service codes so authorized hours are used, not exceeded or lost.
* Enter all schedule changes in Hipp Health accurately, including correct billable and non-billable codes.
* Update calendars for PTO, leaves, and departures, and support payroll with timesheet and code audits.
* Produce weekly reports on scheduled versus authorized hours, utilization, and cancellations for each clinic.

  

**Communicate & Improve the Process**

* Serve as the main scheduling contact for families, clinicians, intake, and billing at both sites.
* Handle sensitive conversations with families and staff calmly, clearly, and with urgency when needed.
* Improve scheduling workflows and time-off procedures as our clinics grow.
* Protect client privacy and follow HIPAA privacy and security requirements.

**What Success Looks Like**

* **First 30 Days:** Complete onboarding and HIPAA training; learn our clinics, staff, clients, and Hipp Health workflows; and take over day-to-day scheduling and callout coverage with support.
* **First 90 Days:** Independently own weekly schedules at both clinics, handle same-day callouts, and track scheduled versus authorized hours for every client.
* **First 6 Months:** Deliver accurate weekly scheduling, utilization, and cancellation reports for each clinic, and flag recurring cancellation patterns to clinical leadership.
* **First 12 Months:** Consistently keep authorized hours covered across both clinics, maintain accurate schedule and code data, and help improve scheduling and time-off procedures.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Prior scheduling experience in ABA, behavioral health, or another healthcare setting.
* Experience scheduling high volumes of clients and staff, ideally across more than one location.
* Working knowledge of ABA service codes, insurance authorizations, and how they drive scheduling.
* Hands-on experience with Hipp Health or a similar ABA practice management platform (such as CentralReach or Rethink).
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, especially Excel or Sheets.
* Strong problem-solving skills and calm judgment under time pressure.
* Clear, warm communication by phone, email, and video.
* High school diploma or equivalent.

  

**Preferred**

* Associate or bachelor’s degree.
* 2+ years of ABA scheduling experience, ideally as a scheduling lead or across multiple sites.
* Familiarity with HIPAA and payroll or timesheet processes.

  

**We'll set you up to succeed. You'll receive hands-on remote training on our clinics, systems, and workflows, with ongoing support from your team and leadership.**

**Career Growth**

As Odyssey continues expanding, successful team members may have opportunities to advance into roles such as **Scheduling Manager**, leading scheduling across a growing number of clinics, setting scheduling standards, and guiding newer team members. This is a potential career path based on performance and organizational growth, not a guaranteed promotion.

**Why Odyssey Autism?**

For children in ABA therapy, consistency matters. A missed or uncovered session can mean lost progress. **Your job is to help make sure scheduling never becomes a barrier to a child's care.** You'll join a BCBA-led team that values accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement, and you'll see the impact of your work every day.

**Duties & Responsibilities:**

  

* Provide high-level administrative support to the Director of Strategic Accounts and Business Development Executives, ensuring efficient day-to-day operations and effective coordination of activities.

* Support business development initiatives by coordinating participation in industry trade shows, conferences, workshops, client events, charitable engagements, and other networking opportunities.

* Manage and continuously improve Business Development shared folders and records, including reports, databases, analytics files, and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate the preparation, inventory, and distribution of client appreciation items, branded merchandise, executive gift packages, thank-you correspondence, and other client engagement materials.
* Assist with the development and compilation of post-event reports, analyses, and summaries, including trade show recaps, business development reviews, and executive reporting materials.
* Collaborate with business development leadership and team members to support strategic initiatives, special projects, and operational priorities.
  

**Salary Range**: $52,800-71,000 annual salary plus non-guaranteed annualized bonus program.

  

**Basic Qualifications**

  

* Minimum of three years of progressive administrative support experience in a professional business environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Sales, Communications, or a related field; equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.
* Demonstrated experience supporting one or more senior leaders or executives, including managing complex calendars, coordinating competing priorities, preparing reports, and facilitating efficient workflow management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite applications, including Excel and PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot, and other AI platforms and tools.
* Experience handling confidential and sensitive information with a high degree of discretion and professionalism.
* Ability to support in-person and virtual events as needed.
* Ability and willingness to travel up to 10% as business needs require.
* Experience with ProjectMark (or other CRM’s) and Axis/Dynamics 365 preferred
* Local to the East Coast area.
  

**Skills & Abilities**

  

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through on commitments.
* Exceptional customer service skills with a commitment to providing responsive and professional support.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Demonstrated adaptability and flexibility in response to changing priorities and business needs.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally and effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Strong business writing, editing, proofreading, grammar, and punctuation skills.
* Professional presence and the ability to represent the organization in a positive and professional manner.

The Senior Administrative Coordinator provides high-level administrative, financial, and operational support for a designated region. This remote role is responsible for managing regional organization and reporting. The position serves as a key liaison between operational deliverables and regional leadership. Accountability, consistency, and the timely execution of business priorities are critical to success in this role. This role requires strong organizational skills, financial acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

**Compensation: $27.00/hr. (US Dollars)**  
The pay listed is the salary range for this position. Any specific offer will vary based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, and alignment with market data. You may be eligible to participate in a Company incentive or bonus program.

**Executive & Administrative Support**

* Provides direct administrative support to the Director of Operations.
* Manages calendars, meeting coordination, project tracking, action item follow-up, and operational communications.
* Prepare presentations, reports, dashboards, meeting materials, and executive summaries.
* Coordinates regional meetings, business reviews, operational calls, and leadership communications.
* Maintains organized electronic records, documentation, and business files in accordance with company standards.
* Serves as a central point of coordination between field operations, corporate functions, and leadership teams.

**Data Management, Reporting & Spreadsheet Administration**

  

* Develops, maintains, and manages complex spreadsheets, databases, trackers, and reporting tools supporting operational performance.
* Consolidates information from multiple sources to generate accurate regional reports and dashboards.
* Maintains reporting schedules and ensures timely delivery of operational, compliance, staffing, and financial reports.
* Performs quality assurance reviews of reports to ensure data integrity and accuracy.
* Creates standardized reporting templates and tools to improve consistency and efficiency throughout the region.

**Compliance, Governance & Operational Support**

  

* Maintains compliance trackers and monitors completion of required operational, safety, training, and contractual obligations.
* Supports internal audits, governance reviews, customer reporting requirements, and account compliance initiatives.
* Partners with operational leadership to ensure adherence to company policies, contractual standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Monitors outstanding compliance actions and drives timely completion through follow-up and reporting.

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

  

* Produces clear and professional correspondence, presentations, and executive communications.
* Maintains strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate efficient business operations.
* Handles sensitive and confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
* Ensures timely communication of deadlines, reporting requirements, and operational priorities.

**Process & Continuous Improvement**

  

* Identifies opportunities to enhance administrative, reporting, financial, and compliance processes.
* Develop standardized templates, procedures, and tools that improve efficiency and consistency across the region.
* Supports automation and process-improvement initiatives involving reporting, financial administration, and operational workflows.
* Assists leadership with special projects and strategic initiatives as assigned.

**Other duties as assigned**

Job duties may be modified at any time to support operational requirements, organizational priorities, compliance obligations, or business initiatives.

* High School Diploma or GED required; associate or bachelor’s degree in business administration, Finance, Accounting, Operations Management, or related field preferred.
* Minimum 3-5 years of administrative, operational, financial, or executive support experience.
* Experience supporting senior leadership, regional management teams, or multi-site operations preferred.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, reporting, and data analysis.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
* Experience managing budgets, expense reports, financial tracking, and P&L support activities.
* Ability to create, maintain, and analyze complex spreadsheets and reporting tools.
* Strong understanding of compliance reporting, governance processes, and administrative controls.
* Exceptional organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive business information with discretion.
* Proven ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining strong collaboration across teams.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with leaders and stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

*LifeStance Health Values*

* Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.
* Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.
* Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.
* One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

*Benefits*  
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.

**Job Summary:**

The Practice Coordinator is responsible for managing the front office daily activities for their practice location, ensuring quality customer service to in-person and remote patients and clinicians.

  

**Compensation**: Starting pay of $21- 22/hour depending on experience, plus quarterly bonus/incentive potential

**Location**: 495 Thomas Jones Way Suite 204 Exton, PA 19341

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

**Operational Excellence:**

* Create a positive work environment; be a culture carrier and support in-office clinician and staff engagement activities to promote LFST culture, engagement, and connection.
* Conduct schedule prep process for all patients to ensure all paperwork and documentation is complete, credit card on file is current, demographics are accurate, and patient chart is prepared.
* General office duties, cleanliness, and appeal, such as sorting office mail, scanning documents, e-faxes, shared office email and office upkeep, to ensure the practice is running smoothly and prepared for patients and clinicians.
* Communicate with peers, clinicians, and patients in ways that support patient care and clinician satisfaction.

**Patient Support:**

* Provide exceptional customer service, responding quickly and appropriately to patient needs, and being prepared to manage potentially difficult or sensitive situations by following Crisis and De-escalation Processes.
* Manage front desk responsibilities including greeting and checking patients in/out in a courteous manner.
* Provide support to patients with requests via phone, email, and/or portal with payment/billing related questions, scheduling needs, release requests, miscellaneous inquires, etc.
* Manage queues within the phone system, ensuring calls are answered timely to ensure excellent customer service.
* Assist patients with telehealth access, Patient Portal issues, and other troubleshooting as needed.

* Handle any urgent requests; triage patient issues and resolution, i.e., direct to correct departments or escalate for assistance.
* Collect all in-person and telehealth co-payments and account balances at the time of service.
* Complete insurance eligibility verification and reach out to patients to resolve any issues.

**Clinician Support:**

* Provide general clinician support – assist clinicians with administrative questions and/or duties such as sending letters, faxes, etc.
* Coordinate with clinicians pertaining to any additional patient questions.
* Support clinician schedules by auditing for appointment accuracy.
* Maintain a pleasant, secure, and motivational working environment in the Practice.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Ability to multitask and prioritize duties to support delivery of high-quality patient experience.
* Ability to work independently and as a team member.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Proficient in using Computer Software Applications (Microsoft Office & EMRs)
* Comfortable handling sensitive and confidential Information (HIPAA)

**Education and Experience:**

* High School or equivalent required, associates/bachelor’s degree, preferred.
* 1+ years of experience in healthcare operations, customer service, or similar role or setting preferred.

**Physical Requirements:**

* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, bend, talk, and hear. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee must be able to lift and/or move objects up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Genetic Counseling and Risk Assessment | ChristianaCare

  
  

**Work Schedule:**

* Monday-Friday, 8:00am- 4:30pm

### ***St. Luke's is proud of the skills, experience and compassion of its employees. The employees of St. Luke's are our most valuable asset! Individually and together, our employees are dedicated to satisfying the mission*** ***of our organization which is an unwavering commitment to excellence as we care for the sick and injured; educate physicians, nurses and other health care providers; and improve access to care in the communities we serve, regardless of a patient's ability to pay for health care.***

The Manager, Practice Operations leads and manages the operations of assigned practices to ensure successful practice operations, effective execution of operational workflows, a patient experience consistent with SLPG standards, and a highly engaged practice operations team.

* Performs all leadership and managerial functions across the employee life cycle for direct reports including hiring, onboarding/orientation, performance management, ongoing coaching and development, recognition, etc.).
* Ensures operational readiness for clinical and administrative operations (e.g., developing employee schedules; maintaining supply inventory, office equipment and furnishings, cleanliness; facilitating daily huddles; updating time management systems; maintaining Point of Care licensing, etc.).
* Manages practice operations, workflow execution, employee collaboration and overall patient experience.
* Partners with other organizational functions (e.g., Billing/Coding, Facilities/Property Management, Hospital Entity departments, Access Center, etc.) to coordinate and facilitate effective practice operations.
* Maintains strong collaboration and connectivity with Access Center operations and centralized functions (e.g., POD, Capacity Management, etc.) to enable seamless operations and optimal patient/employee experiences (e.g., transfers, triage protocols, template changes, huddles, POD/practice connectivity, etc...).
* Serves as point of escalation and addresses critical operational, technological, patient, and employee issues.
* Achieves expected practice financial performance through judicious expense management, efficient resource utilization, volume growth, and execution of expected financial management best practices.
* Utilizes organizational tools to monitor practice performance (volume, patient satisfaction, productivity, quality, etc.), identifies opportunities for improvement, and develops/implements improvement strategies via a multidisciplinary, team-based approach.
* As applicable, effectively utilizes practice leads (e.g., Practice Operations Coordinators, Clinical Coordinators, etc.) to support oversight of practice workflows/processes, etc.
* Ensures adherence to policies , procedures, and SLPG Access Governance Principles.
* Other duties as assigned.

**PHYSICAL AND SENSORY REQUIREMENTS:**

Sitting for up to three (3) hours per day; three (3) hours a t a time. Standing for up to eight (8) hours per day; eight (8) hours at a time. Walking for up to six (6) hours per day; one (1) hour at a time. Frequent fingering, handling, grasping, twisting, and turning as it relates to therapeutic procedures. Consistently lift, carry, and push objects up to 10 pounds. Occasionally lift, carry, and push objects up to 75 pounds. Rarely lifting with assistance, up to 100 pounds. Rarely pushing and pulling patients weighing up to 300 pounds in a wheel chair or stretcher. Occasionally stooping and bending. Must be able to perceive attributes of an object through touch. Seeing as it relates to normal near, far, color, and peripheral vision. Hearing as it relates to normal conversation and high and low frequencies.

**EDUCATION:**

Bachelor’s Degree in health, business, or related field preferred

**TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Minimum of 2+ years of medical office or practice operations experience, including at least 1 year in a healthcare setting
* Experience managing or supporting daily operations such as staffing coordination, scheduling, patient access, workflow management, and regulatory compliance
* Demonstrated ability to supervise staff, support performance management, and maintain service and quality standards

Competencies required for this job:

* Strong business acumen
* Skilled in all forms of communication
* Effectively able to develop self and others
* Leadership presence/EQ, presents as a composed and competent leader
* Quality focused
* Exudes patient and customer service focus
* Shares a compelling strategy that inspires others

Additionally, you are encouraged to upload a current resume, including all work history, education, and/or certifications and licenses, if applicable. It is highly recommended that you create a profile at the conclusion of submitting your first application. Thank you for your interest in St. Luke's!!*

***SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.***

**Job Description Summary:**

The Assistant General Counsel will report directly to the Deputy Chief Legal Officer and play a key role in supporting the Company's EPC and other business development, commercial and procurement contracting, regulatory compliance, risk management, and day-to-day business operations. This position will serve as a trusted legal advisor to cross-functional business teams, including executive leadership, helping drive business objectives while proactively managing legal and commercial risk.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess a strong combination of construction, corporate and renewable energy experience, with the ability to provide practical, business-oriented legal advice in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment. The successful candidate will be comfortable handling complex transactions, leading negotiations, influencing business decisions, and partnering with senior executives. The successful candidate will also have multiple years of managing and developing other attorneys in an in-house legal department.  
  
This role can be based full-time in our office in San Diego, CA, Frisco / Dallas, TX or Denver, CO. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

**Job Description:**

* *This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned*

**Position Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Serve as a trusted legal advisor to business teams, including executive leadership, on commercial, operational and regulatory matters.
* Exercise sound judgment grounded in ethics, integrity, accountability, and transparent communication.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including business leaders, executives, developers, contractors, and outside counsel.
* Evaluate legal and business issues holistically, balancing risk mitigation with commercial objectives.
* Foster a collaborative, solution-oriented approach across the organization. Monitor and advise on legal, regulatory, legislative, and industry developments impacting the renewable energy, infrastructure, and construction sectors.
* Partner with business development, finance, and executive teams on a broad range of project and commercial transactions.
* Identify legal and business risks associated with new market opportunities and develop practical mitigation strategies.
* Assist in developing and enhancing legal processes, policies, and governance structures that support organizational growth and scalability.

Commercial Contracting

* Lead and support the drafting, review, negotiation, and administration of a broad range of complex commercial agreements, including:
* Engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) agreements
* Construction subcontracts
* Supply and procurement agreements
* Equipment purchase agreements
* Operations and Maintenance (O&M) agreements
* Master service agreements
* Commercial customer contracts
* Non-disclosure agreements
* Real estate agreements
* Memorandums of understanding and framework agreements
* Provide strategic guidance regarding contract interpretation, change orders, claims management, and dispute avoidance.
* Collaborate with Operations, Procurement and Business Development teams to support successful project execution and commercial outcomes.

Risk Management, Compliance and Governance

* Assist in developing, implementing, and maintaining corporate compliance, governance, and risk management programs.
* Support corporate entity management, organizational recordkeeping, and governance requirements.
* Advise business leaders on regulatory requirements affecting renewable energy development, construction operations, labor matters, and commercial activities.
* Conduct legal risk assessments and recommend practical solutions to minimize exposure while supporting business objectives.

Claims, Disputes and Legal Operations

* Support the management of construction, commercial, and project-related claims and disputes.
* Assist with the coordination of outside counsel regarding litigation, arbitration, mediation, and other dispute resolution matters.
* Assist in overseeing outside counsel performance, legal budgets, accruals, and matter management.

**Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:**

* Juris Doctor (J.D.) from an ABA-accredited law school.
* Active bar membership in good standing.
* 12-15+ years of legal experience, including significant experience at a nationally or regionally recognized law firm, and at a public company and/or other sophisticated in-house legal department.
* Managed other attorneys for 5+ years
* Demonstrated experience in renewable energy, construction, infrastructure, project development, or related industries.
* Strong experience negotiating and drafting complex commercial agreements and construction-related contracts.
* Proven ability to provide practical, solutions-oriented legal guidance.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple competing priorities.
* Excellent written, verbal, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to identify legal risks proactively and develop commercially reasonable solutions.
High degree of professional judgment, integrity, executive presence, and business acumen.  

  

*Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without requiring employer sponsorship now or in the future.*

Overview:

Thank you for considering IT Concepts dba Kentro, where innovation drives opportunity and collaboration leads to success. Our dynamic community of experts is fully committed to advancing our customers' missions, fostering professional growth, and making a positive impact on our communities.

By joining our supportive community, you will find that Kentro is dedicated to your personal and professional development. Together, we can drive meaningful change, spark innovation, and achieve extraordinary milestones.

Kentro is hiring for a **Talent Acquisition (TA) Ops Coordinator** supporting the Corporate TA team and all contracts. The Talent Acquisition (TA) Coordinator provides administrative, systems, and customer service support throughout the recruiting and hiring lifecycle. Reporting to the TA Operations Lead, this role helps maintain accurate iCIMS records, conducts initial requisition quality reviews before TA Manager review, coordinates post-offer activities and start-date communications, and responds professionally to general inquiries submitted through Digital HQ. The Coordinator works closely with Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, HR Business Partners, Personnel Security, IT, Corporate teams, and Service Delivery stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate handoffs. This is an opportunity for a detail-oriented, dependable individual to learn recruiting operations, technology, and the federal government contracting business while supporting a high-performing team.

**Location:** This position can be performed remotely within the continental United States and will support Eastern Time working hours.

**Compensation Range:** The anticipated base salary range for this position is $45,000- 65,000 annually as non-exempt employee and reflects Kentro’s good-faith expectations at the time of posting. Final compensation is determined based on the role’s requirements, relevant skills, experience, education, certifications, work location, applicable security clearance requirements, market conditions, internal equity, and contract requirements.

This Job Description reflects the primary duties of the role; however, it is not intended to be all‑inclusive. Team members may be asked to take on additional responsibilities in alignment with customer expectations, business needs, and Kentro’s culture of collaboration and adaptability.

Responsibilities:

### **Recruiting Operations**

* Conduct initial completeness and accuracy checks of new and updated requisitions in iCIMS, including job information, required fields, supporting documentation, and workflow status, before routing to the TA Manager for review.
* Maintain requisition and candidate records, update statuses, monitor outstanding administrative actions, and follow up with recruiters and stakeholders on missing information.
* Support daily recruiting coordination, documentation, and task tracking while following established procedures and escalation paths.
* Assist with maintaining SOPs, job aids, templates, and process documentation as directed by the TA Operations Lead.

### **Analytics & Reporting**

* Perform routine data-quality checks to identify incomplete, inconsistent, duplicate, or outdated ATS records and coordinate corrections.
* Support recurring reporting by validating source data, maintaining trackers, and preparing basic status updates as assigned.
* Flag recurring errors, delayed handoffs, and data-quality concerns to the TA Operations Lead.

### **Technology & Systems Support**

* Learn iCIMS ATS and CXM workflows, user functions, and basic administrative capabilities under the guidance of the TA Operations Lead.
* Assist with approved system updates, testing, user guidance, and documentation; escalate configuration, access, integration, and vendor issues to authorized system owners.
* Help maintain system cleanliness and support adoption of updated workflows and tools.

### **Candidate Experience & Post-Offer Coordination**

* Complete and track assigned administrative steps after offer acceptance, ensuring required records and notifications are updated promptly.
* Confirm anticipated start dates with responsible stakeholders and communicate changes to TA, HR Operations, Personnel Security, IT, Corporate teams, and Service Delivery as appropriate.
* Monitor outstanding pre-employment and onboarding items, follow up with process owners, and escalate potential delays; do not independently approve clearances, screenings, or hiring exceptions.
* Support accurate, professional candidate and internal communications throughout the post-offer handoff.

### **Internal Customer Service & Quality Control**

* Monitor and respond to assigned Digital HQ tickets involving general TA questions and requests with timely, courteous, accurate communication.
* Document ticket actions, coordinate answers with appropriate subject-matter experts, and escalate policy, sensitive employee, technical, or approval matters when necessary.
* Conduct routine checks of requisition and candidate documentation against established TA standards and help maintain audit-ready records.
* Collaborate professionally with recruiters, TA Managers, Corporate departments, and Service Delivery personnel to resolve administrative needs and improve handoffs.

### **Growth & Process Improvement and Sourcing**

* Participate in training to build knowledge of government contracting, TA systems, hiring processes, and relevant compliance requirements.
* Identify practical improvements to checklists, data hygiene, communications, and administrative workflows and share recommendations with the TA Operations Lead.
* Demonstrate initiative, accountability, confidentiality, responsiveness, and a willingness to take on broader responsibilities as skills develop.
* As the Company grows, additional opportunities to conduct sourcing using Kentro tools to support the overall Hiring Process.

Qualifications:

* College education (associate’s degree, bachelor’s degree, or relevant college coursework) with 0–3 years of related experience in administrative support, recruiting coordination, HR, customer service, or business operations; OR, for candidates without college education, generally 3 or more years of relevant administrative, business operations, or government contracting experience. Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, time management, and ability to follow through on multiple priorities.
* Professional written and verbal communication and a service-oriented approach to internal customers.
* Working familiarity with Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams and ability to learn new systems quickly.
* Sound judgment in handling confidential information, following established procedures, and escalating issues appropriately.
* Demonstrated reliability, initiative, teamwork, curiosity, and willingness to learn.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Experience with iCIMS or another applicant tracking or HR system.
* Exposure to federal government contracting, recruiting, HR operations, or employee onboarding.
* Experience using ticketing systems, maintaining records, supporting audits, or assisting with system testing.

**Clearance Requirement:**

* US Citizen or Lawful Permanent Resident (Green Card)
* Willing and able to obtain and maintain Public Trust Clearance or higher

Benefits:

**The Company**

We believe in generating success collaboratively, enabling long-term mission success, and building trust for the next challenge. With you as our partner, let’s solve challenges, think innovatively, and maximize impact. As a valued member of our team, you have the unique opportunity to work in a diverse range of technology and business career paths, all while supporting our nation and delivering innovative technology solutions. We are a close community of experts that pride ourselves on creating an environment defined by teamwork, dedication, and excellence.

We hold three ISO certifications (27001:2013, 20000-1:2011, 9001:2015), two CMMI ML 3 ratings (DEV and SVC) and CMMC Level 2 Certification.

**Industry Recognition**

Growth | Inc 5000’s Fastest Growing Private Companies, DC Metro List Fastest Growing; Washington Business Journal: Fastest Growing Companies, Top Performing Small Technology Companies in Greater D.C.

Culture | Northern Virginia Technology Council Tech 100 Honoree; Virginia Best Place to Work; Washington Business Journal: Best Places to Work, Corporate Diversity Index Winner – Mid-Size Companies, Companies Owned by People of Color; Department of Labor’s HireVets for our work helping veterans transition; SECAF Award of Excellence finalist; Victory Military Friendly Brand; Virginia Values Veterans (V3); Cystic Fibrosis Foundation Corporate Breath Award

**Benefits**

We offer competitive benefits package including paid time off, healthcare benefits, supplemental benefits, 401k including an employer match, discount perks, rewards, and more. We invest in our employees – Every employee is eligible for education reimbursement for certifications, degrees, or professional development. Reimbursement amounts may fluctuate due to IRS limitations. We want you to grow as an expert and a leader and offer flexibility for you to take a course, complete a certification, or other professional growth and networking. We are committed to supporting your curiosity and sustaining a culture that prioritizes commitment to continuous professional development.

We work hard; we play hard. Kentro is committed to incorporating fun into every day. We dedicate funds for activities – virtual and in-person – e.g., we host happy hours, holiday events, fitness & wellness events, and annual celebrations. In alignment with our commitment to our communities, we also host and attend charity galas/events. We believe in appreciating your commitment and building a positive workspace for you to be creative, innovative, and happy.

* Provide multi‑system support for staff and franchise teams, including account assistance, troubleshooting, and general system guidance
* Review and reconcile data inconsistencies across platforms; escalate issues as needed
* Manage and prioritize a high volume of tickets, requests, and projects
* Deliver non‑initial system training, job aids, and resource materials to staff and franchise operators
* Update templates for member welcome emails and texts
* Create new user profiles, reset passwords, and confirm user details

aecedd8eef1f489c4bd0.description:
OnTrac is hiring a Senior Specialist, Operations Business Intelligence!
  
  
Are you eager to join a dynamic and expanding company where you can both learn and make a meaningful impact? If you possess a strong sense of empathy, enjoy assisting others, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and excel at problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today to connect with a recruiter!
  
  
Founded in 1986, OnTrac has evolved into the leading provider of same-day and next-day delivery services in the U.S. for premier e-commerce and product-supply businesses, including five of the largest retailers in the U.S.
  
  
**Location:** Remote - This position may be performed remotely in states where the company is authorized to employ individuals.
  
**Compensation:** The expected starting base pay range for this position is $84,000 - $105,000, with full potential base salary range over a successful candidate’s tenure in the position of $84,000 - $126,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, internal equity, and other job-related factors.
  
  
**Employment Logistics:**  
The Senior Specialist, Operations Business Intelligence leads the development of clear, trustworthy reporting and visualizations for the Operations organization. This role owns how field performance is measured and communicated, from frontline operators to the executive team, as well as externally to customers. You will partner closely with Operations, Quality, Loss Prevention, Customer Experience, Product, Engineering, and Data Analytics teams to identify what is happening, understand why it is happening, and determine what actions should follow. Success requires strong analytical judgment, independent ownership, reliable reporting foundations, and clear data storytelling in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  
  
**Unpacking the Benefits:**  
Employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package which may include:
  
  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Life and short- and long-term disability coverage
* 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match
* Flex vacation in states other than CA, CO, IL, MA, MT, and NE, with accruals up to 96 hours for first year of employment with tenure-based increases up to 160 hours
* Two (2) floating holidays per year
* Paid sick leave\*
* Six (6) paid company holidays
* Two (2) weeks paid pregnancy disability leave, four (4) weeks paid parental bonding leave
* Additional wellness and employee assistance programs

Benefits eligibility and offerings are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and company policies.
  
  
**The Must-Haves:**  

* 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or operations analysis within warehouse fulfillment, logistics, supply chain, e-commerce, or a similar environment
* Expert-level ability to build insights-driven dashboards in Power BI or similar BI tools using large, complex datasets
* Strong experience with data modeling and KPI design
* Strong SQL skills, including the ability to extract, validate, and interpret operational data
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence Operations leaders and communicate across business stakeholders, Data Engineering, and Product teams through clear analysis and storytelling
* Familiarity with warehouse systems and operational event data, including WMS scan events, exception codes, labor tracking, and station performance
* Experience supporting multi-site performance reviews and standardizing KPIs across a network
* ​​It is the responsibility of every position to understand and adhere to the security guidelines outlined in OnTrac’s Acceptable Use policy and to conduct their activities accordingly.​

**Your Mission in Motion:**  
A summary of key responsibilities for the role is outlined below. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business objectives.
  

* Dashboard development & reporting ownership: Build, maintain, and monitor standardized, user-friendly Power BI dashboards and reports across sites and functions, using clear definitions and consistent reporting logic.
* KPI design & operational insights: Translate operational goals into actionable KPIs and visualizations that support decision-making at both the site and network levels.
* Data visibility & cross-functional partnership: Partner with cross-functional teams to identify, scope, and address gaps in data visibility.
* Data requirements & business alignment: Work with Product and Engineering teams to ensure the organization collects the data required to support business objectives.
* Data pipeline partnership & optimization: Collaborate with Data Engineering and Analytics teams to design, optimize, and maintain data pipelines that support data availability, accuracy, and efficiency.
* Reporting governance & trusted metrics: Establish reporting best practices through standardized metric definitions, documentation, and governance, creating a trusted single source of truth.

**Paving your way to your success:**  

* You bring a passion for data and its ability to create meaningful business value.
* You are highly curious and eager to investigate complex operational problems.
* You are self-driven, proactive, and comfortable operating with ownership and ambiguity.
* You influence Operations leaders and communicate effectively across business stakeholders, Data Engineering, and Product teams through clear analysis and storytelling.
* You stay close to the business, build high-trust reporting, and use data to drive real-world operational improvements.

**Posting Timeline:**  
This job posting is anticipated to remain open for at least 15 days from the date of posting
  
  
**Disclosures:**  

* Washington state employees are eligible for up to 56 hours of paid sick leave annually.

The salary range above represents the national range for this position. The salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at OnTrac, and the actual base salary offered may vary depending on several factors including, but not limited to: Geographic location, candidate experience and qualifications, job-related skills and competencies, market alignment, and financial considerations.
  
  
Compensation decisions are made based on the specific circumstances of each hire to ensure fair and competitive pay.
  
  
**ADA Statement:**  
We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals. If you require reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, perform essential job functions, or access other employment benefits, please contact Human Resources.
  
  
If you are excited to be part of our team and grow with our OnTrac family, we invite you to apply!
  
  
OnTrac is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer
  
Lasership, Inc. dba OnTrac Final Mile with its affiliates, including OnTrac Logistics, Inc. (collectively, "OnTrac" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or age. Join us in our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you are excited to be part of our team and contribute to our talent acquisition efforts, we invite you to apply.

The Procurement Coordinator is responsible for tactical, day-to-day processing of vehicle purchase orders and revisions for all equipment types. Opportunities for process enhancements will be actively identified.

Review and process purchase orders and revisions for all types of equipment or National, Local and Inside Sales,. Review SPO (Sample Purchase Order) content to ensure specification compatibility when processing purchase orders. Process orders created in-house as directed. Maintain proper documentation as orders are processed. Prioritize revisions and order release for on-ground units. Apply correct VSS (Vehicle Specification System) codes to all purchase orders as appropriate. Complete all required workflow documents and procedures associated with the management of all purchase orders. Observe guidelines and follow-up with approval requirements for specification content, Early Replacement Approval, and Capital Expenditures. Manage the process and workload to ensure prompt and accurate release of purchase orders and revisions

Contact OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers), dealers or non-standard suppliers to obtain copies of quotes, missing or incorrect specifications, verify delivery schedules and freight requirements

Observe supplier's scheduling deadlines and prioritize order release. Observe supplier's currency exchange deadlines and prioritize order release. Ensure production schedules and order guidelines are met

Respond to field inquiries and e-mails promptly. Follow up with sales persons when suppliers have issues to make sure all are resolved and handled in a timely manner

Contact sales person or lease administrator when changes are required. Obtain approval from sales persons prior to making specification changes on purchase orders

Proactively communicate any problems that arise or recurrent issues to management. Analyze exception reports and communicate any issues to management

Mail, e-mail, fax, print and/or re-print purchase orders to suppliers.

ee2d6e5c07be809cb528.title: CAT Outside Claims Specialist
ee2d6e5c07be809cb528.description:
You have a clear vision of where your career can go. And we have the leadership to help you get there. At CNA, we strive to create a culture in which people know they matter and are part of something important, ensuring the abilities of all employees are used to their fullest potential.

This individual contributor role operates under technical direction and within defined authority limits to manage commercial property/casualty claims of low to moderate complexity and exposure. The position involves field-based investigations and coordination, including reviewing coverage, determining liability and compensability, securing relevant information, arranging property damage appraisals, and negotiating settlements. Responsibilities are carried out in accordance with company protocols, quality standards, and customer service expectations. Regular communication with insureds, customers, and internal partners is required, and the role may be dedicated to specific account(s).

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities:**

Performs a combination of duties in accordance with departmental guidelines:

* Manages an inventory of commercial property claims with low to moderate complexity and exposure (typically up to $50,000), including field-based losses.

* Conducts on-site investigations and inspections of loss locations; prepares estimates, diagrams, uploads photos, and completes inspection reports using company systems and guidelines.

* Verifies policy coverage and establishes timely and adequate reserves by reviewing and interpreting policy language and estimating potential claim valuation.

* Exercises judgment to determine liability and compensability by gathering pertinent information, taking recorded statements, and collaborating with experts.

* Coordinates with insureds, claimants, witnesses, business partners, and vendors to evaluate claims and identify early resolution opportunities.

* Authorizes and ensures claim disbursements within authority limits by negotiating settlements and escalating to management when appropriate.

* Contributes to customer satisfaction by interacting professionally and effectively with all stakeholders, providing timely updates, and responding promptly to inquiries.

* Collaborates with internal and external partners—including attorneys, account representatives, agents, underwriters, and experts—to facilitate best claim outcomes.

* Identifies and refers subrogation, salvage, and potential fraud opportunities to appropriate internal units (Recovery, SIU).

* Accurately inputs and maintains claim data to reflect circumstances and support business outcomes.

* Maintains compliance with state/local regulatory requirements and stays current on commercial insurance laws, regulations, and industry trends.

* Achieves quality and cycle time standards by following company guidelines, ensuring proper documentation, and issuing appropriate claim disbursements.

*May perform additional duties as assigned*

  
  

**Skills, Knowledge & Abilities**

* Solid knowledge of claims and insurance industry theory, products, and practices.

* Demonstrated technical expertise and product-specific knowledge.

* Developing foundational understanding of commercial insurance and claims processes.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to demonstrate empathy and deliver exceptional customer service.

* Effective interpersonal and negotiation skills; able to interact professionally with all levels of internal and external business partners.

* Ability to build and maintain collaborative relationships across departments and with external stakeholders.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with critical thinking and the ability to develop viable alternative solutions.

* Capable of exercising independent judgment and making sound business decisions, including cost-benefit evaluations.

* Proven ability to manage time and resources independently, handling multiple priorities in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

* High level of productivity with strong organizational and time management skills.

* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and able to quickly learn and adapt to business-related software systems.

* Flexible and adaptable to changing environments, processes, and priorities.

* Values diverse perspectives and fosters inclusive decision-making.

* Ability to handle claims with a proactive, long-term view aligned with business goals and objectives.

* Willingness and ability to travel 50–75% of the time to visit loss sites and perform field inspections.

* Available for Catastrophe (CAT) deployment, including travel on short notice for extended periods.

* Must have and maintain a valid driver’s license.

* Must be able to obtain and maintain proper licensing as required.

  
  

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. Professional designations preferred.

* Typically a minimum one to three years claims experience.
