### **Job Summary**

Provides support in administration of the Appeals and Grievance process. Serves as a liaison between Members and the Plan with appeals regarding denied claims/services, referrals, membership and benefit issues and concerns regarding quality of care or service. PresentsMember appeals to the Plan Medical Staff and Center for Medicare/Medicaid Services contracted reviewer.

### **Job Duties**

* Prepares and facilitates Member appeals, complaints and grievances by communicating directly with Members, their Representatives, Vendors and Medical Providers and their Representatives to obtain the necessary information to complete the appeal process successfully within the time period allowed by regulation.
* Investigates the full details of the appeal and complaints and grievances by consulting with, but not limited to, health care providers, legal services, internal medical staff and administration.
* Provides timely and accurate documentation of all communications with involved parties within both the individual case file and departmental tracking database.
* Ensures that all complaint, appeal and grievance time frames are met as dictated by guidelines set forth by the Department of Labor (DOL), the Department of Health (DOH), the Department of Insurance (DOI), the National Committee for Quality Insurance (NCQA), and the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS).

* Coordinates activities for review committees and educational sessions with other Health Plan departments to ensure overall compliance is maintained.
* Acts as the primary resource regarding the complaint, appeal and grievance processes to all other Health Plan and external entities, communicating with all entities involved throughout the appeals and grievance process.
* Maintains strict compliance with all applicable laws and regulations set forth by the Federal and State regulatory bodies, continually reviewing updates as pertains to regulatory changes and implement those changes within current departmental practices, policies and procedures.
* Makes suggestions for policies and procedures covering all regulatory and accreditation standards for all lines of business.
  

Work is typically performed in an office environment. Ability to travel is required. Accountable for satisfying all job specific obligations and complying with all organization policies and procedures. The specific statements in this profile are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements considered necessary to successfully perform the job.

### **Our Vision & Values**

Everything we do is about making better health easier for our patients, our members, our students, our Geisinger family and our communities.

2cfc7f834859fe117bff.title: Recruiting Coordinator
2cfc7f834859fe117bff.description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.

Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.

The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a highly organized Recruiting Coordinator to own interview scheduling for our global hiring teams. You’ll coordinate interviews across multiple time zones, keep candidates and interviewers informed, and make sure every candidate has a smooth, professional experience. If you love solving logistical puzzles and staying several steps ahead, this role is for you!

**What you’ll do**

* Schedule phone screens, video interviews, panel interviews, and onsite visits for candidates and interviewers across North America, EMEA, and APAC time zones
* Manage complex, multi-interviewer schedules, finding workable windows and handling last-minute changes and reschedules quickly
* Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process, providing clear, timely communication and confirming all details, including time zone conversions
* Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to understand interview plans, priorities, and timelines
* Maintain accurate candidate records and interview activity in our applicant tracking system
* Send calendar invites, video conferencing links, interview guides, and preparation materials to candidates and interviewers
* Track interview feedback and follow up with interviewers to keep hiring decisions moving
* Coordinate travel and logistics for onsite interviews when needed
* Identify ways to improve scheduling efficiency, such as building interviewer pools, templates, and scheduling best practices

**What you’ll have**

* 1–3 years of experience in recruiting coordination, scheduling, executive assistance, or a similar high-volume administrative role
* Proven experience scheduling across multiple time zones and managing many calendars at once
* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a friendly, professional tone
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment and stay calm when plans change
* Proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Outlook calendars and video tools like Google Meet, Zoom, and/or Teams
* Experience with an applicant tracking system such as Ashby, Greenhouse, and/or Lever
* Flexibility to occasionally work early mornings or late afternoons to support global time zones

**Nice to have**

* Experience with scheduling automation tools (for example, GoodTime, Calendly, or Ashby’s scheduling features)
* Experience supporting technical or international hiring
* Familiarity with candidate experience best practices

Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.

Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.

Compensation Range: $66.3K - $75K

6d6fbb238b694122057a.title: Remote Credentialing Coordinator
6d6fbb238b694122057a.description:
**We are looking for an excellent Dental Credentialing Coordinator to join our practice!**
==========================================================================================

**Job Type:**

Full-time: Mon-Fri 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Hourly Rate: $19.00 - $25.00 DOE

Location: Remote/Hybrid

Picture yourself working in a fun, rapidly growing pediatric dental office, where a unique experience is guaranteed daily. Since launching Children's Dental FunZone in 2002, our mission has been simple: We treat your kids as our own. After 23 years, we still uphold our core values of Integrity, Excellent Customer Service, Accountability, and Teamwork. These values not only guide how we care for our patients but also how we support our employees.

**Position Summary**

The Credentialing Coordinator keeps every provider and clinical team member across our pediatric dental offices fully licensed, permitted, and enrolled with payers so they can see patients and the practice can bill. The role owns initial credentialing, re-credentialing, Denti-Cal and Commercial Plan enrollment, and expiration tracking.

The role works closely with provider recruiting, payroll, office managers, and billing to make sure no provider starts seeing patients before they are cleared.

**Provider credentialing and payer enrollment**

* Complete initial credentialing for new dentists, pediatric dentists, and specialists: collect and verify licenses, DEA registration, NPI, education, board certification, malpractice coverage, work history, and references.
* Prepare and submit Medi-Cal Dental provider applications, rendering-provider additions, and service-office updates for each professional corporation and location.
* Enroll providers with contracted dental plans (PPO, HMO and Medi-Cal), and track each application through approval and effective date.
* Manage re-credentialing and revalidation cycles so no provider lapses with any payer.
* Notify recruiting, scheduling, office managers, and billing when a provider is cleared to see patients under each plan.

**License, permit, and certification tracking**

* Maintain a tracking system for expiration dates on all licenses, permits, and certifications, including DDS/DMD licenses, DEA registrations, Dental Board sedation and anesthesia permits, RDA and RDH licenses, radiation safety, coronal polish, pit-and-fissure sealant, BLS/CPR, and malpractice coverage.
* Send advance renewal reminders (90, 60, and 30 days) to employees and their managers, and escalate items at risk of lapsing.
* Verify all licenses and permits through primary sources such as the Dental Board of California and Dental Hygiene Board of California.

**Compliance and screening**

* Run and document monthly exclusion checks against the OIG LEIE, SAM.gov, and the Medi-Cal Suspended and Ineligible Provider List.
* Keep complete, audit-ready credentialing files for every provider and clinical employee.
* Support payer audits, site reviews, and internal compliance reviews with timely documentation.
* Protect provider personal information in line with HIPAA and company confidentiality policies.

**Coordination and reporting**

* Partner with provider recruiting on start dates, so credentialing timelines are built into onboarding.
* Coordinate with payroll and HR on entity assignments when providers work across multiple professional corporations.
* Report weekly on open applications, pending approvals, and upcoming expirations by location.
* Respond to payer and provider inquiries, and resolve claim holds tied to enrollment issues with the billing team.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

*Required*

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* 2+ years of credentialing, provider enrollment, or medical/dental office administration experience.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for tracking and reporting.

*Preferred*

* Dental credentialing experience, especially Medi-Cal Dental enrollment.
* Experience in a DSO, multi-location practice, or multi-entity organization.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Close attention to detail and accuracy in forms, dates, and identifiers.
* Strong organization: able to manage dozens of open applications and deadlines at once.
* Clear written and verbal communication with providers, payers, and office staff.
* Persistence in following up with payers and state agencies until applications close.
* Sound judgment with confidential personal and licensing information.
* Knowledge of California dental licensing categories and Dental Board permit types.
* Ability to work independently and escalate risks early.

***Equal Opportunity and Acknowledgment***

*Children's Dental FunZone / Rodef Dental Group is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law, and we consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act.*

*This description summarizes the main functions of the role and is not an exhaustive list of duties. It does not create an employment contract, and employment remains at-will.*

Join Children's Dental FunZone, where we are committed to providing comprehensive pediatric dental care and orthodontics for children, toddlers, and teens. Our team is revolutionizing pediatric dental care through a patient-centric approach built on teamwork, flexibility, and a dedication to oral health and compassionate care.

5d726c15af05fcef9640.title: Delivery Operations Supervisor
5d726c15af05fcef9640.description:
**Delivery Operations Supervisor – Reading, PA**

**Title:** Delivery Operations Supervisor

**Department:** Operations

**Location:** Reading, PA Distribution Center

**Reports To:** Operations Manager – Reading

**Position Status:** Full Time

**Shift Schedule:** Day Shift (early-morning start to lead driver loadout; flexibility required based on business needs)

**Exempt Status:** Exempt Salary

**About CDS Logistics:** At CDS Logistics, we are specialists in last mile delivery services for kitchen cabinets, windows, doors, and appliances. We service our customers through a nationwide network consisting of over 80 locations making over 1 million deliveries annually to homes, job sites, and retail locations. Our team-oriented approach, together with our proprietary technology, enables us to exceed our customers’ expectations.

We are not perfect, but we try to be. We hold ourselves to the highest standards, ensuring every customer is treated with respect and every order is handled as if it were our own. We support our team members to ensure their career success with training programs, accessible leadership, and ongoing talent development.

**Our Mission:** “Creating Customers by Servicing Customers”

**Our Guiding Principles:**

1. Put Safety First

2. Respect for Others

3. Treat Customer Orders Like Our Own

4. Deliver Measurable Excellence

5. Pursue Relentless Improvement

**About the Job:**

CDS Logistics & Home Services is seeking a hands-on leader to run day-to-day delivery operations at our Reading, PA distribution center. The Delivery Operations Supervisor owns the outbound side of the facility, from morning driver loadout through proof of delivery and next-day paperwork, and provides the operational support, reporting, and safety monitoring that keep the facility performing. This role leads our independent contract driver teams operating 26 ft box trucks, partners closely with the warehouse lead and with CDS’s centralized Customer Service and Routing teams, and reports directly to the Reading Operations Manager.

The primary goal of this position is simple: every customer order is delivered safely, on time, complete, damage-free, and scanned, while maintaining high customer satisfaction for all business executed through the Reading driver teams.

**Delivery Operations Supervisor:**

This role will focus on driving delivery performance at the Reading facility through hands-on leadership on the dock, strong communication, and disciplined daily follow-up. Success in this role requires urgency, attention to detail, computer literacy, and the ability to hold contractor teams accountable fairly and consistently.

**Successful applicants will be able to:**

* Perform quality work within deadlines.
* Interact and communicate professionally with drivers, internal teams, and external customer groups.
* Prioritize daily tasks in consideration of organizational strategic goals.
* Lead by example on the dock and coach in the moment.
* Work independently while communicating and coordinating efforts with the Operations Manager, warehouse team, Customer Service, Routing, and regional leadership.

**Essential Job Functions:**

**Driver Team Leadership & Contractor Relationships**

* Serve as the daily leader and point of contact for independent contract drivers and third-party driver service providers supporting the Reading outbound schedule.
* Set clear expectations and hold driver teams accountable to CDS and customer standards, equitably and consistently.
* Coordinate backup drivers or teams to cover dropped or open routes so every scheduled route goes out.
* Support the Operations Manager in sourcing, onboarding, and orienting new contract driver teams on CDS standards and customer requirements.
* Communicate SOP changes, customer requirements, and monthly safety topics to driver teams.
* Help promote a culture that encourages top performance, high morale, and ownership.

**Morning Loadout & Dock Control**

* Lead the daily driver loadout to ensure every route leaves complete, on time, and loaded to product-handling specifications.
* Perform a leader loadout audit every morning; audit truck loading to prevent damage and maximize cube utilization.
* Drive zero shorts at loadout: locate missing pallets or pieces in the warehouse or on trucks and resolve with the warehouse lead before trucks depart.
* Provide drivers with override codes, per policy, only when items cannot be located at time of delivery.
* Assist with re-receives and execute dock master tasks as needed.
* Communicate all loadout issues to the Operations Manager, warehouse lead, and regional leadership.

**Driver Manifest Packet Preparation & Paperwork**

* Prepare and email driver manifests and packets for the next day, ensuring all required documentation is included and accurate.
* Process driver manifests the day after delivery; ensure all driver paperwork is turned in and email the prior day’s manifests to Accounting.
* Process AWC paperwork and inbound truck paperwork with CDS order numbers.

**Real-Time Route Monitoring & Driver Support**

* Monitor Driver Manifest Order Status in Vision Ops throughout the day and audit each driver team’s performance.
* Monitor delivery time frames and drivers delayed at stops; act early to protect the customer’s delivery window.
* Ensure drivers complete 1-hour pre-calls using their scanners or the CDS app.
* Monitor and respond to all driver alerts (DAWGs), including potential lates, shortages at loadout, shortages at delivery, manually keyed pieces that were scan-loaded, 1-hour pre-call failures, and late deliveries without a reason code.
* Monitor driver communication channels and provide timely support on delivery issues; use creative problem solving when a service failure occurs to still meet customer expectations.
* Partner with Customer Service on reschedules and customer concerns, and escalate issues to the Operations Manager when needed.

**Delivery Compliance & Order Close-Out**

* Audit PODs and packing slips early in the day to confirm drivers are performing to standard.
* Complete open orders on the alerts page: verify delivery and complete the order, or note the reason, uncomplete, and reschedule with the customer or hand off to Customer Service.
* Work missing POD alerts, scan missing PODs to the order in Vision Ops, and coach drivers on scanning at delivery.
* Review the OS&D email folder daily for damages found by driver teams at loadout; note each order with a description of the damage and the piece, using the manufacturer’s label photo.

**Inbound Schedule Visibility**

* Monitor Reading inbound schedules through inbound request emails and the SMART system for AWC inbound activity.
* Maintain visibility of expected inbound shipments and communicate updates or concerns to the warehouse lead and Operations Manager.

**Driver Scorecards & Performance Reporting**

* Review driver scorecards weekly; identify trends, coaching opportunities, and repeat issues (including damage, lates, and scanning).
* Provide scorecard breakdowns and actionable insights to the Operations Manager and support driver performance improvement plans.
* Execute timely data collection and keep delivery metrics current on the facility Daily Management board.
* Root-cause missed metrics within 24 hours and log countermeasures with an owner and due date.

**Samsara Safety Monitoring & Fleet Support**

* Monitor Samsara driver activity and identify coachable events (for example, phone use, seatbelt, speeding, and harsh driving).
* Coach drivers directly, document the coaching, and escalate repeat behavior to the Operations Manager.
* Ensure vehicle inspections are completed on schedule and support the Penske truck lease relationship, including preventive maintenance scheduling and out-of-service trucks.
* Support incident reporting and continuous improvement of driver safety and compliance.

**Customer Account Support & Continuous Improvement**

* Provide day-to-day operational support for key accounts, including AWC and COE, and partner with customer points of contact to meet their expectations.
* Participate in Lean, Kaizen, and Daily Management activities and recommend process improvements for delivery operations.
* Perform all other duties as assigned.

**Key Performance Expectations:**

* Drive results against company targets for: Customer On-Time (COT), on-time delivery to window, scan compliance (receipt, loadout, and delivery), zero shorts at loadout, damage and claims, Samsara safety score, Customer Experience Score (CES), and cubes per truck.
* Maintain accurate, real-time visibility of every route and order for the Reading facility.
* Ensure timely communication between drivers, the warehouse, Customer Service, and leadership.
* Improve driver compliance with company processes and customer expectations through proactive monitoring and coaching.
* Provide accurate reporting and actionable insights to Operations leadership.

**Key Success Factors:**

* Strong communication both up and down.
* Ability to communicate expectations and hold driver teams accountable equitably.
* Ability to communicate with employees and stakeholders in person and via email professionally and clearly (strong written and verbal communication).
* Able to communicate and reinforce the company message, leading with our guiding principles in mind (cultural leader and personal example).
* Able to support driver teams through change and establish consistently executed best practices.
* Strong ability to impact metrics and KPIs.

**Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or GED.
* Minimum of 2–3 years’ experience in logistics, transportation, or warehouse operations, including at least 1 year in a lead or supervisory role or directly supporting driver teams.
* Experience working with independent contract drivers or delivery service providers.
* Proficient with Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel; comfortable with RF scanners, warehouse management systems, and route visibility tools.
* Strong communication, organization, prioritization, conflict resolution, creative problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Proven scheduling abilities and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Valid driver’s license.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 3–5 years’ experience in the logistics industry; 3PL, final mile, or big-and-bulky delivery (cabinets, windows, doors, appliances, furniture) strongly preferred.
* 1–2 years’ experience supporting driver teams and monitoring their performance by set KPIs.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish.
* Experience with Samsara or other fleet telematics, and familiarity with DOT/FMCSA safety requirements.
* Strong proficiency with data analysis tools in Excel.
* Lean Management certification of Yellow Belt or higher.

**Competencies:**

* Exceptional communication skills.
* The ability to execute on and attain actionable goals.
* High level of attention to detail.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* High sense of urgency.
* Determination to see the job through to completion.

**Physical Demands:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear, sit, stand, and walk for 8+ hours per day; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee will spend significant time on the dock during loadout and must occasionally lift, push, pull, and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus to perform activities such as reviewing data, viewing a computer terminal, and auditing truck loads.

**Travel:**

Little travel is expected; occasional travel to other CDS facilities for training or support may be required.

**Work Environment:**

This job operates in both a warehouse/dock and office environment. The employee will be exposed to forklift and truck traffic, noise, and seasonal temperature changes on the dock, and must follow all safety procedures and wear required PPE. This role routinely uses office equipment such as computers, scanners, copiers, and telephones.

**Other Duties:**

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Pay: $45,000.00 - $57,500.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

83ef8f3b1da42bd2465e.title: Premier Specialist
83ef8f3b1da42bd2465e.description:
DISA Global Solutions is a leading safety and compliance provider supporting more than 55,000 customers worldwide, including over 30% of the Fortune 500. With 1,600+ team members across 30+ locations, we’ve delivered innovative solutions since 1986 and process more than 20 million orders each year. As a multi-year Top Workplaces award winner, DISA offers competitive pay, robust benefits, and a collaborative, growth-focused culture. Employees enjoy ongoing training through our internal learning and development team, monthly appreciation events, and numerous opportunities for career advancement.

**Position Summary:**
=====================

As a **Specialist, Premier** , you will serve as a dedicated liaison for our premier accounts, ensuring an exceptional client experience through proactive, expert-level support, and timely resolution of complex service issues. In this role, you will develop trusted relationships with customers, deliver white-glove service, and ensure that service standards, compliance protocols, and customer needs are fully met. This role also involves collaboration across departments and may include customer-specific projects such as specialized reporting, system training, and strategic planning support.

  
  

**Essential Functions & Responsibilities:**
===========================================

* Serve as daily point of contact for key accounts, responding to inquiries via phone, email, and other communication platforms with professionalism, urgency, and accuracy.
* Manage and prioritize all support needs for assigned premier accounts, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction and adherence with service level agreements (SLAs).
* Proactively engage customers through outbound outreach efforts (calls, emails, and strategic touchpoints) to better understand client pain points, sentiment, and overall experience, and share actionable insights with internal stakeholders.
* Participate in strategic account reviews and assist in executing customer-specific initiatives, onboarding tasks, or program enhancements.
* Provide real-time, account-specific client training and user support, including navigation of DISA platforms, ordering procedures, reporting capabilities, and issue resolution guidance. Serve as the primary resource for client users requiring refresher training, workflow assistance, and platform utilization support related to their day-to-day account activities.
* Escalate complex or escalated issues, to internal teams (Compliance, IT, Technical Support, Operations) as needed.
* Maintain expert-level knowledge of assigned accounts and operational procedures to serve as a trusted advisor to customers.
* Deliver specialized reporting and custom solutions tailored to the needs of premier clients.

**Resident Services Specialist | Windsor Loudoun County - Ashburn, VA**

**Summary:**

As the Resident Services Specialist, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing the smooth operation of our community, ensuring exceptional experience for our customers, and fostering a strong sense of community. Working closely with your direct manager, your responsibilities will include prioritizing key areas such as move-in satisfaction, renewal acquisition, and serving as the primary liaison to the Support Services Team. This role also works closely with the Sales Leadership team to ensure a smooth customer transition from prospect to resident. By creating a warm and inviting environment, organizing resident appreciation events, and problem solving resident issues, you will actively contribute to building a vibrant community that meets our residents needs today, tomorrow, and every day.

For the fifth year in a row, Windsor Communities is the recipient of the **2025 Kingsley Excellence Award** achieving the top award for Overall Customer Service.

**Compensation:**

Hourly: Starting at $57,042 annually. The full range is $57,042 - $71,315 depending on years of experience, tenure, and location.

Bonus: Average monthly bonus potential is 20% of base salary paid out quarterly.

Total Starting Annual Compensation Potential:

* $68,450 ($57,042 + $11,408 bonus potential)

**Benefits:**

* Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401k, and PTO.
  + 1 hour of paid sick and safe time for every 30 hours worked, 10 days of paid vacation time accrued bi-weekly, 6 weeks of paid parental leave after completing one year of employment, 10 paid holidays annually, and up to 3 floating days.
* Opportunities for growth—we invest in our team’s development.

For more information, visit: Benefits!

**Responsibilities:**

**Customer Focus:**

* Ensures timely response to resolve or escalate resident issues appropriately.
* Oversees and directs resident package management efforts, ensuring effective delegation of tasks to the sales team.
* Ensure all mandatory move-in details and steps have been completed by the on-site team in advance of the move-in day and conduct either an in-person or virtual move-in orientation with new residents. Empowered to delegate move-in orientation to another on-site associate if necessary.
* Performs move-in day welcome appointments to greet and orient new residents to the community.
* Conducts post-move in communication to residents to ensure customer satisfaction.
* Focus on maintaining and achieving set company goals for positive customer relationships with both prospect and residents monitored through customer survey program. Responsible for responding to both positive and negative survey responses.
* Develops and executes creative programs to increase resident satisfaction rates, such as resident appreciation events, referral programs and resident engagement activities.
* Implements and contributes to the online reputation plan set by the Operations Manager by responding to both positive and negative online reviews, open requests for contact or Kingsley surveys.
* Conducts necessary resident communication efforts in support of direct manager, office closures, capital projects, and customer retention efforts.

**Sales Strategy:**

* Leads the management of Funnel CRM resident queue management.
* Partnership with Sales Manager/Operations Manager to ensure success of Unguided Tour Program. Greets prospects, troubleshoots related software issues, and escalates concerns to Sales Manager and Operations Manager. Delegates to sales team where necessary.
* Walks tour path, common areas, identified unguided tour apartments, vacants, and made ready apartments weekly to ensure exemplary appearance to prospects and residents.
* Completes Tour by 10 inspections at assigned properties daily to ensure tour path and Tour24 daily readiness. Empowered to delegate Tour by 10 inspections to another on-site associate if necessary.
* Assists the Operations Manager with the management of the resident renewal program by conducting warm calls and renewal follow-up.
* Reports on all renewal program activity, including uncommitted, recent notices, and recent commitments, to Operations Manager on a weekly basis.
* Knowledgeable about the job market, local businesses, community activities, and community demographic life-style preferences. Conducts bi-annual competitor shopping.
* Promotes Bilt program to all residents on an ongoing basis and leverages BILT Rewards reporting to ensure resident engagement and participation.

**Administrative Support:**

* Monitors and responds to EliseAI delinquency resident queue, mentions, handoffs, and tasks needing on-site response.
* Manages the notice to vacate process overseeing the execution of all associated paperwork and system related action items.
* Attends, when invited, the monthly RSM call to review renewal program and high priorities for the property.
* Partners with the Prior Resident Support team by providing necessary information to the Support Services team, overseeing the execution of the Move Out Inspection within the inspection software platform, and facilitating the promotion and administration of the TIDY program.
* Partners with the Resident Payment Support team by processing payments, delivering delinquency notices and remaining up to date on local and state landlord-tenant laws.
* Ensures completion of resident files completed by Sales Team. Works with Service Manager to ensure timely key preparation and inspections are completed prior to move in day.
* Reviews applicable Power BI (Business Intelligence) Reporting daily to monitor property success with tools such as the role incentive and enablement dashboard.

**Performance Expectations:**

* Full compliance with completed deposit accounting files with missing information 10 days after move out.
* Full compliance with on-time delivery of delinquency notices.
* Achieve company outlined resident retention benchmarks.
* Achieve company outlined quarterly Kingsley Score goal.
* Achieve company outlined monthly ORA scores versus company average and company goal.
* Achieve economic occupancy target.

**Role Expectations:**

* Maintains close partnership with Service Manager to positively impact communication and processes around the Work Order and Make Ready Maintenance Program.
* Ability to demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft 365 product suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, Microsoft Teams).
* Working knowledge of property management and prop-tech systems.
* Required to report to assigned Windsor Community. Not eligible for hybrid or remote work.

**Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; some college coursework preferred.
* One to two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience will also be considered.
* Experience working in a multifamily environment and/or property management operations.
* Knowledge of Funnel CRM preferred.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 required.
* Transferable apartment industry sales related experience preferred.

Windsor Communities is dedicated to creating exceptional experiences for both residents and associates.

Join a growing organization that embodies our core values of “Accountable, Inclusive, Energizing and Courageous,” Windsor's mission is to create communities where people feel truly cared for. Start your Windsor career now!

93b65b0ca9f7c1ea03a9.description:
**NOTE: THIS POSITION IS FULLY REMOTE!**

**Position Objective:** As a Senior Human Resource Specialist,apply a broad range of advanced skills and expertise in the full range of federal HR areas including but not limited to staffing, classification, processing, benefits, recruitment, compensation, SES programs, work life programs, policy and employee and labor relations. In support of the Dept. of Homeland Security (DHS), U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), Office of Human Capital (OHC), Human Resources Operations Center (HROC).

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

**Staffing Activities**

* Review position applications to determine basic qualifications, adjudicate veterans’ preference, and prepare selection certificates for issue.
* Apply pay setting calculations for use by to extend job offers.
* Perform law enforcement pay setting to include accurate conversion of general pay and special pay schedules to the law enforcement pay schedule.
* Develop and review standard operating procedures (SOP) and job aids for existing, new, or emerging staffing programs.
* Develop and build specialized ad-hoc applicant metrics, reports, and associated spreadsheets.
* Validate applicant selections.
* Interpret and apply laws, rules, and regulations, to include Executive Orders (EO’s) Title 38, Delegated Examining Unit (DEU) regulations, 5 Code of Federal Regulations (CFR), the Vet Guide, and other regulatory guidance to federal hiring actions.
* Respond to applicant and internal customer concerns and inquiries.
* Review applicant status determinations when challenged by internal/external candidates and managers.
* Monitor, revise, and maintain reports and files.
* Develop staffing process checklists and maintain tracking spreadsheets.
* Coordinate and serve as a liaison with customers as required.
* Perform data entry into position management and other related ICE systems as required.
* Prepare, issue, and track tentative selection notices.
* Coordinate job offers, release requests, setting of enter-on-duty (EOD) dates, and coordinate training classes for applicants.
* Coordinate issuance and return of security paperwork for applicants including Electronic Questionnaires for Investigations Processing (e-QIP) initiations and conduct regular status checks with the ICE Personnel Security Division (PSD).
* Familiarity with USA Staffing Record EOD actions in ICE databases as required.
* Assist with audit of staffing and recruitment case files.
* Perform quality assurance for the oral interview process and enter results into appropriate ICE databases.
* Advise and assist hiring managers in performing job analyses to fill existing or new positions: draft vacancy announcements, develop interview questions, score benchmarks based on job analysis results, and guidance on forming interview panels.
* Participate and/or contribute as an active member of a team for human capital initiative(s).
* Provide support for HR specialists who perform recruitment and staffing duties for an assigned block of services.
* Instruct candidates on the proper way to complete and submit employment applications and review for complete and accurate information.
* Explain basic merit promotion procedures to employees.
* Maintain merit promotion folders to keep accurate logs.
* Initiate the pre-employment process to include security, medical, drug and/or fitness tests as required for the position.
* Download and transmit SF75 information to other Federal agencies as required.

**Operational Classification Activities**

* Lead a group of contractor staff with the daily processing of Position Management System Online (PMSO) Builds, SF-52 routing, and SF-corrections as applicable.
* Operate several independent HR processing systems (e.g., TOPS, NFC, ESP).
* Assign SF-52s and HC Link service tickets ensuring a balance of tickets among contractor staff.
* Monitor ESP and HC Link work request submissions and timely assign for processing.
* Keep abreast of the status and progress of work, and make day-to-day adjustments in accordance with established priorities, and obtain assistance from the Section Chiefs on problems that arise, such as backlogs.
* Aid contractor staff with specific tasks and job techniques.
* Perform routine work in progress checks.
* Run system generated reports from numerous HR systems for use by various HR Units and ICE program office.
* Coordinate with other HROC Units in the correction of SF-52’s.
* Respond to program office

**Operational Processing Activities**

* Process Personnel Actions (SF52) in compliance with Department of Homeland Security (DHS), Office of Personnel Management (OPM) and National Finance Center (NFC) rules and procedures, processes recruitment, Career Ladder Promotion (CLP), Change to Lower Grade (CLG). Detail actions, Temporary Promotions (TPRO), Law Enforcement Pay Actions, Administratively Uncontrollable Overtime (AUO), Reassignment actions etc.
* Apply a wide range of personnel, payroll and benefit concepts, laws, policies practices, analytical and diagnostic methods to address technical issues:
* Development of SOPs for existing, new, or emerging personnel functions.
* Provide administrative support by responding to questions, complaints, problems, or situations, and providing explanation of policy and procedures.
* Support audit – KPMG, A-123, ICU, Internal and external audits – provide guidance, documentation.
* + Provide technical assistance to end users on HR automated systems, procedures, and applications.
* Review, assign, and route SF52s to process personnel actions in ESP related to the duties of the section.
* Train and monitor the workload of HRAs to ensure they perform duties accurately and timely.
* Perform daily monitoring of personnel systems for actions related to the duties of the section, following up with the employee and or services for missing information.
* Process complex settlement case/tasking requiring History Correction Process (HCUP) by providing analysis of alternative options on a full range of pay-related issues.
* Support research and investigation of facts involving personnel problems and other projects.
* Test enhancements projects with the Human Resources Information Technology (HRIT) team.
* Monitor and maintain human resources reports and files.
* Research discrepancies with benefits, veterans’ preference, and SCDs, etc.

**Operational Retirement & Benefits Activities**

* Provide federal benefits expertise to advise current and former employees, annuitants, eligible family members, and managers on complex benefits problems and inquiries.
* Provide individual employee counseling on retirement options; Thrift Savings Plan (TSP) and worker’s compensation/injury benefits; and eligibility requirements for life, health, and long-term health insurance.
* Research employee eOPF issues/errors related to benefits and conduct service audits.
* Provide solutions and develop corrective guidance or operating procedures to know concerns.
* Assist to process documents related to benefits to include retirement packages.
* Process SF52 documents for retirements and death in service actions.
* Prepare retirement and survivor benefits computation for law enforcement and non-law enforcement employees.
* Assist employees and survivors in preparing retirement applicants, ensuring documentation is accurate and submitted within required deadlines.
* Provide counseling to employees on all aspects of the TSP to include participation eligibility, eligibility for retroactive TSP error corrections, and to employees leaving federal service (or their survivors) on the benefits available from their TSP accounts.
* Provide validation of retirement coverage to pay technicians.
* Prepare communication related to employee benefit and retirement materials to ensure supervisors and employees are fully and currently informed.
* Administer the Federal Employees Group Life Insurance (FEGLI) and the Federal Employees Health Benefits (FEHB) programs for serviced activities.
* Establish local procedures, publicity, and informational materials related to the FEGLI and FEHB programs.
* Advise employees and supervisors on difficult questions relating to FEGLI and FEHB (Typical issues involve interpreting provisions of the Spouse Equity Act, and the Temporary Continuation of FEHB Coverage Program; interpretation and applicability of Comptroller General decisions pertaining to retroactive payments; and determining enrollment eligibility for initial coverage outside the normal enrollment periods).
* Provide advisory services on various leave entitlement matters such as the Family and Medical Leave Act and the Family Friendly Leave Act; annual, sick, restored, administrative, and military leave; Voluntary Leave

**Employee Engagement & Selection Support Activities**

* Contribute to the design and administration of studies, surveys, and projects.
* Coordinate activities in alignment with strategic business needs and established project timelines
* Develops and coordinates internal review systems to track planning activities and external review systems to monitor adherence to established business standards and processes.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Master’s Degree required
* 10 years of federal Human Resources experience.
* Delegated Examining Certification and HRM Certificate from an accredited academic institution.
* When a Task Order includes tasks related to drug testing and site collection, the candidate must possess knowledge of Health and Human Services Guidelines for federal drug testing and possess a valid driver’s license. The contractor candidates must be capable of air travel.
* Must be U.S. citizen or Legal Permanent Resident and must currently reside in the United States or its Territories. Additionally, employees are required to have resided within the United States or its Territories for three or more years out of the last five.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Intermediate to advanced technical proficiency in the full Microsoft Office Suite.

* Strong written and oral communication skills.
* Advanced presentation skills.
* Ability to work effectively within a group or individually.
* Advanced organization and leadership skills.
* Understanding and familiarity with industry best practices.
* Exceptional time management skills.
* Depending on the specific tasks, may be required to have advanced knowledge of NFC, eOPF, WebTA, SharePoint, Oracle, Java Script, SQL, and other information technology system.

* This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required by this position.

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

POSITION DESCRIPTION:
  
Provide technical, educational, operational and sales support to assist the district in meeting Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) sales and customer service objectives. CRM seeks collaborative candidates who will meet our customer expectations by striving without reserve for the greatest possible reliability and quality in our products, processes, and systems by being accountable, having a voice and acting promptly.
  
  
This role supports the Irvine territory and requires candidates to reside within the assigned area and travel regularly to customer accounts. Clinical Specialists must be available to support urgent customer needs and participate in weekend, holiday, and occasional after-hours coverage as business needs require. A valid driver's license, active auto insurance, and a driving record that meets company standards are required.
  
  
To find all Cardiac Rhythm Management Clinical Specialist roles available please use #crmcs in the key word search at Medtronic Careers  

The Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) portfolio delivers therapies designed to restore, support, and protect every heartbeat through advanced pacing, defibrillation, and remote monitoring solutions. CRM's unique ability to pair proven life-saving therapies with intelligent technology gives clinicians and patients greater confidence. Clinical impact and innovation come together to improve lives through meaningful patient outcomes.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

* **Provide** technical support for CRM devices and therapies by performing system checks/interrogations, supporting implants, troubleshooting issues, and applying knowledge gained through comprehensive CRM field training.
* **Coordinate** operational support by ensuring accurate patient documentation, managing inventory and equipment resources, maintaining programmer software, and assisting with daily coverage logistics to meet customer and business needs.
* **Educate** physicians, hospital staff, office personnel, and field team members on CRM products, therapies, and solutions, while supporting the onboarding and development of new Clinical Specialists and Sales Representatives.
* **Collaborate** with sales leadership and field partners to understand customer needs, market dynamics, and the value of Medtronic CRM products and solutions.
* **Identify** customer opportunities, support purchase order activities, monitor competitive trends, and provide actionable feedback to help achieve sales objectives.
* **Maintain** technical expertise by staying current on new CRM products, therapies, solutions, and patient management offerings to effectively support customers and clinical outcomes.
* **Travel** extensively within the assigned territory to support customer clinics, hospitals, and business meetings, with frequent independent driving – approximate 80% of the time
* **Perform** physical job requirements, including frequent two-handed lifting of up to **40 lbs.** , sitting, standing, and walking for **8+ hours per day** , and regularly bending, stooping, squatting, and maintaining balance.
* **Work** effectively in clinical environments with exposure to eye protection, infectious disease, and radiation, while wearing **7-9 lbs.** of lead for extended periods, utilizing computers and mobile devices, and maintaining the vision capabilities necessary to support patient care and field-based responsibilities.

  
  

**Required Qualifications:**

  

High School Diploma PLUS a minimum 6 years **OR** Associate’s Degree PLUS a minimum 4 years **OR** Bachelor’s Degree PLUS a minimum 2 years of work experience in healthcare, field sales, or work experience utilizing complex mathematics, mechanical concepts, science or computing

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in nursing, life sciences, or biomedical engineering
* 2+ years in Cath lab, EP Lab, hospital/clinic with cardiology knowledge Thorough working knowledge of medical terminology and the medical device industry

e39afee2518c10b579c3.title: Global Study Management Associate (gSMA)
e39afee2518c10b579c3.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

**General Description:**

* Supports the Global Clinical Study Manager in global study delivery and ensures that delegated components of clinical studies are executed to expected and specified quality standards, within timelines and budget
* Supports the alignment of study goals with clinical operations goals and objectives under direction of the Global Clinical Study Manager

**Essential Functions of the Job:**

**Cross-Functional Leadership Support &** **Collaboration**

* Supports the Global Clinical Study Manager with the organization and logistics for cross-functional Clinical Study Team (CST) meetings
* Establishes good collaboration with the Global Clinical Study Manager, Regional Clinical Trial Management Associates and other key stakeholders globally and regionally
* Knowledgeable of clinical study operations, including interpretation and implementation of regulatory and ICH-GCP guidelines
* Builds solid knowledge of global clinical trials operations under the guidance of the Global Clinical Study Manager

**Planning** **and Execution**

* Creates and maintains study-level SharePoint and CST distribution lists
* Sets up the study in the appropriate systems e.g. eTMF, CTMS, and makes sure study-level information is kept up to date
* Ensures system access is granted and managed appropriately across the study life cycle, supports user account management for systems used in the study
* Supports the development of various study plans
* Organizes study-specific investigator meetings under supervision of the Global Clinical Study Manager
* Might support the creation and review of site feasibility assessments required for study participation
* Manages and tracks key study deliverables such as screening, enrollment, biological samples and images, data flow and protocol deviations in relevant systems in collaboration with Regional Clinical Trial Management Associates
* Prepares metrics and updates to key deliverables for management as per information available in relevant systems
* Supports the preparation of a study newsletter and other correspondence related to the study conduct (e.g. frequently asked questions, lessons learned) in collaboration with the study team
* Supports the TMF specialist with study-level TMF creation and, as required, maintains the study-level TMF, including regular review and QC of TMF documents as per the study TMF QC plan
* Supports the Global Clinical Study Manager with study drug forecasts and overall study drug supply activities in collaboration with Global Clinical Supplies
* Supports the overall data cleaning activities and contributes to the follow-up of outstanding information
* Supports the Global Clinical Study Manager with planning and execution of the Clinical Study Report

**Quality**

* Supports the identification of operational risks and issues and works with the Global Clinical Study Manager to recommend solutions for discussion with appropriate team leadership
* Learns and shares best practices in clinical operations methodologies, systems and processes with an emphasis on quality and compliance
* Suggest improvements to enhance efficiency and the quality of the work performed on assigned projects

**Budget**

* Supports selection and set-up of vendors for global outsourced activities
* Supports study budget management activities with responsibility for PO setup and payment invoice tracking across all study lifecycles.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* N/A

**Computer Skills:**

* Proficiency in MS Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint and project etc.

**Other** **Qualifications:**

* Knowledge of clinical operations methodologies, understanding of operational aspects of clinical study processes
* 1 or more years of experience in clinical research within Biotech, Pharma or CRO industry

**Travel:**

* Limited travel might be required

**Education Required:**

* Bachelor or higher degree in a scientific or healthcare discipline\*, higher degree preferred.
* *exceptions might be made for candidates with relevant clinical operations experience*

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

* Fosters Teamwork
* Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
* Self-Awareness
* Acts Inclusively
* Demonstrates Initiative
* Entrepreneurial Mindset
* Continuous Learning
* Embraces Change
* Results-Oriented
* Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
* Financial Excellence
* Communicates with Clarity

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

69f261ca5b8690147b0e.title: Veterinary Operations Associate
69f261ca5b8690147b0e.description:
Job Summary: The Operations Associate provides administrative and logistical support to MOVES Mobile Specialty Services nationwide. This individual will help ensure clinical teams have the equipment, supplies, resources, and operational support necessary to deliver efficient, high-quality veterinary care.

The Operations Associate works closely with the Operations Manager, MOVES Board Certified Specialists, Company leadership, and external vendors. They coordinate equipment needs, inventory, shipping, repairs, and general operational requests across markets. This individual serves as a resource for clinical team needs related to equipment, supplies, laboratory, and fleet. . The role requires strong organization, communication, problem-solving, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while providing responsive support to geographically dispersed teams.

The ideal candidate has a background in veterinary medicine, understands the day-to-day operational needs of a clinical environment, and enjoys finding practical solutions that allow veterinary teams to focus on patient care.

**Qualifications:**

* Eligible to work in the United States

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree is preferred.

**Experience**

* 5-10 years of clinical veterinary experience (required).
* 3 years of specialty veterinary experience (required/preferred).
* Work related history involving oncology, cardiology, internal medicine or surgery (preferred).
* Familiarity with veterinary medical equipment, supplies, and clinical operations.
* Experience with equipment ordering, inventory management, shipping logistics, and vendor coordination preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple requests and priorities across geographically dispersed teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable troubleshooting problems, identifying solutions, and following issues through to completion.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and other operational software.
* Ability to act with integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality.
* Ability to collaborate with others in a virtual setting, including professionals of all levels.
* Proficiency in iOS and MacOS.
* Ability to work independently while maintaining strong communication and collaboration with the Operations team.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Ability to lift 50 pounds.
* Able to operate a motor vehicle

**Job Duties & Details:**

**1. Market & Clinical Operations Support**

* Provide operational support to MOVES markets across veterinary service lines.Partner with specialists, technicians, clinical directors (DCOs), and leadership to identify and address operational needs.
* Assist with coordinating equipment, supplies, and resources necessary for daily clinical operations.
* Support existing markets as service needs evolve, grow, or change.
* Assist with operational coordination for new service launches, market expansions, and changes in clinical services.
* Identify recurring operational challenges and work with the Operations Manager to develop consistent solutions.
* Serve as a reliable point of contact for general operational questions and requests.

**2. Equipment & Inventory Management**

* Coordinate equipment requests and fulfillment across markets, ensuring teams have access to necessary equipment and supplies.
* Track equipment assignments, locations, availability, and condition.
* Maintain accurate equipment inventories and tracking documentation.
* Coordinate equipment replacements, repairs, loaners, exchanges, and temporary solutions when equipment is unavailable or not functioning properly.
* Monitor equipment needs and proactively identify potential shortages, replacement needs, or maintenance requirements.
* Assist with evaluating equipment requests and identifying cost-effective solutions in partnership with the Operations
* Manager and appropriate clinical leadership.
* Help establish consistent processes for equipment tracking, maintenance, and accountability.

**3. Shipping & Logistics Coordination**

* Coordinate shipping and receiving of equipment, supplies, replacement parts, and other operational materials between markets, vendors, and team members.
* Prepare shipping labels, track shipments, and confirm delivery.
* Coordinate return shipping, equipment exchanges, and vendor service requests.
* Monitor outstanding orders and proactively follow up on delayed, incomplete, or missing shipments.
* Communicate shipping timelines and delivery updates to affected team members.
* Identify opportunities to streamline shipping processes and reduce unnecessary shipping expenses.

**4. Equipment Troubleshooting & Vendor Coordination**

* Serve as an initial point of contact for equipment-related operational questions and concerns.
* Assist clinical teams with basic equipment troubleshooting and coordinate additional support when needed.
* Communicate with manufacturers, vendors, and service providers regarding equipment issues, repairs, warranties, replacements, and returns.
* Track outstanding equipment issues and follow through until resolution.
* Coordinate loaner equipment or alternative arrangements when equipment is unavailable or requires service
* Escalate urgent equipment concerns that could impact patient care or scheduled procedures to the Operations Manager and appropriate clinical leadership.
* Maintain organized records of vendor communications, service requests, and equipment resolutions.

**5. Purchasing & Supply Coordination**

* Assist with coordinating supply and equipment orders across markets.
* Monitor supply needs and help identify opportunities to consolidate orders or improve purchasing efficiency.
* Support purchasing within established budgets and approval processes.
* Communicate with vendors regarding product availability, pricing, backorders, and order fulfillment.
* Assist with identifying cost-effective alternatives when requested items are unavailable or outside budget.
* Help monitor recurring supply needs and establish consistent ordering processes where appropriate.

**6. Administrative & Operational Process Support**

* Maintain equipment tracking spreadsheets, inventory records, and operational documentation.
* Assist with developing, updating, and maintaining SOPs related to equipment management, shipping, inventory, and operational support.
* Provide regular updates to the Operations Manager regarding outstanding requests, equipment concerns, and operational priorities.
* Assist with reviewing equipment utilization and identifying opportunities to improve resource allocation across markets.
* Support operational projects and organizational initiatives as assigned.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, and communication across the Operations team.

**Schedule:** Full-time (Tuesday-Friday); 10 hour shift, hours to be provided to individual team member. MOVES observes the following holidays: New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas Day. Team members are expected to arrive to work on time and are required to clock in at the beginning of their shift and to clock out at the end of each shift.

**Total Rewards Package:** MOVES offers a comprehensive compensation package including but not limited to:

* 100% Employer paid premiums for the employee’s medical/dental/vision and 50% employer paid premiums for dependent health/dental/vision; eligibility on the first of the month after your start date
* Company provides Short Term & Long Term Disability income benefits
* Company provides $25,000.00 in group life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance
* Paid parental and maternity leave benefits (based on tenure with MOVES)
* Participation in the company 401(k) retirement plan with a company match up to 4%; eligibility begins ninety days after your start date and also provides accessibility to a financial planner
* Participation in the company Stock Option Program
* Access to an Employee Assistance Program

Pay: $55,000.00 per year

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Disability insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid parental leave
* Paid time off
